title: CodeJeNN: A simple C++ neural network generator for physics applications
summary: Machine learning has shown speedups for numerical methods in physics applications, but integrating Python-based libraries into high-performance C++ solvers creates performance bottlenecks. We present CodeJeNN, which bridges this gap by auto-generating self-contained C++ code from trained Keras models for inference. This eliminates external dependencies through minimal inlined functions, allowing seamless integration into existing frameworks. We describe the Keras-to-C++ workflow, supported architectures, and limitations. CodeJeNN is demonstrated through inference benchmarks against Keras in eager and JIT modes and a CFD test case modeling viscosity in a hydrogen-air mixing layer, showing speedups without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.tldr: CodeJeNN是一个自动将训练好的Keras模型转换为自包含C++代码的工具，消除了外部依赖，在保持精度的同时实现了推理加速，并通过CFD测试案例验证了性能提升。
AI.motivation: 将基于Python的机器学习库（如Keras）集成到高性能C++数值求解器中会产生性能瓶颈，需要一种无外部依赖的解决方案来桥接这一差距。
AI.method: 提出CodeJeNN框架，自动将训练好的Keras模型生成为自包含的C++推理代码，通过最小化内联函数消除外部依赖，支持多种网络架构。
AI.result: 在eager和JIT模式下与Keras进行推理基准测试对比，并在氢气-空气混合层黏度建模的CFD测试案例中展示了加速效果，同时不牺牲精度。
AI.conclusion: CodeJeNN成功实现了从Keras模型到C++代码的无缝转换，在保持数值精度的前提下显著提升了推理速度，适用于高性能计算场景。

title: Restoring the uniform density limit in Perdew-Zunger self-interaction correction
summary: The Perdew-Zunger self-interaction correction (PZ-SIC) makes approximate density functionals exact for all one-electron densities, but sacrifices exactness for uniform densities. I show that an alternative to the orbital density ansatz employed in PZ-SIC restores the uniform density limit. The new ansatz also eliminates the need to evaluate approximate density functionals on lobed one-electron densities extracted from smooth many-electron densities, thereby reducing orbital dependence and lobed density error. I demonstrate the alternative ansatz in a broadly accurate nonempirical locally scaled self-interaction-corrected generalized gradient approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种替代PZ-SIC中轨道密度假设的新方法，该方法恢复了均匀密度极限，减少了对轨道依赖和瓣状密度误差，并展示了在非经验局部标度自相互作用校正广义梯度近似中的广泛应用。
AI.motivation: PZ-SIC虽然使近似密度泛函对单电子密度精确，但牺牲了对均匀密度的精确性，需要修复这一缺陷。
AI.method: 提出一种替代PZ-SIC中轨道密度假设的新方案，通过局部标度自相互作用校正来恢复均匀密度极限，避免对光滑多电子密度中提取的瓣状单电子密度评估近似密度泛函。
AI.result: 新假设恢复了均匀密度极限，减少了轨道依赖性和瓣状密度误差，并在非经验局部标度自相互作用校正广义梯度近似中展现了广泛准确性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的替代假设有效克服了PZ-SIC在均匀密度极限方面的不足，提供了一种更准确的密度泛函校正方法。

title: Hyper Boris integrators for kinetic plasma simulations and their connection to 3D rotation representations
comment: 4 pages; proceedings of the 52nd EPS Conference on Plasma Physics (June 29 -- July 3, 2026, Edinburgh, UK)
summary: Particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation is one of the most important research tools in theoretical plasma physics. To solve the motion of charged particles, the Boris method (a.k.a. the Boris integrator/pusher/solver) has been used for more than a half century. Although the Boris solver has good accuracy, the demand for high-accuracy numerical solvers has been increasing, and new integrators have been actively developed. In this contribution, we present novel high-accuracy particle integrators, the hyper Boris integrators, for nonrelativistic kinetic simulations. We further discuss their connection to 3D rotation representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于非相对论动力学模拟的新型高精度粒子积分器——超Boris积分器，并讨论了其与三维旋转表示的联系。
AI.motivation: 尽管Boris方法作为等离子体物理中带电粒子运动求解的标准算法已使用半个多世纪且精度良好，但高精度数值求解器的需求日益增长，亟需开发新的积分器。
AI.method: 提出了超Boris积分器（Hyper Boris integrators）系列新型高精度粒子积分器，并探讨了其与三维旋转表示之间的理论联系。
AI.result: 开发了新型高精度粒子积分器，在非相对论动力学模拟中实现了超越传统Boris方法的精度。
AI.conclusion: 超Boris积分器为等离子体PIC模拟提供了更高精度的数值方案，其与3D旋转表示的内在关联为未来算法优化提供了理论依据。

title: Accelerating Multi-scale Simulations of Nuclear Components via PCYS Interpolation Tables
summary: Zirconium alloy core components in nuclear reactors, such as spacer grids and fuel cladding, undergo anisotropic dimensional changes driven by coupled irradiation creep and growth. While micromechanical crystal plasticity frameworks like the Viscoplastic Self-Consistent (VPSC) formulation capture these microstructurally driven phenomena, their integration into macroscopic Finite Element Method (FEM) solvers is computationally prohibitive for engineering-scale components. To bridge this gap, this work presents a multi-scale framework implemented within the open-source FEM solver Code_Aster. The developed interface uses a 5D Interpolation Table (IT) as a static material surrogate to govern instantaneous viscoplastic responses, coupled with a periodic recalibration and first-order Taylor series linearization scheme to track microstructural drift due to radiation damage without on-the-fly database updates. The predictive accuracy, numerical stability, and performance of this Polycrystal Yield Surface (PCYS) interpolation approach are benchmarked against VPSC-FEM simulations under continuous high-dose irradiation scenarios. Material-level assessments demonstrate that the linearization scheme bounds relative errors below 1% for representative deformation paths, maintaining structural compatibility. Furthermore, structural simulations of a spacer grid domain revealed meaningful computational savings, overcoming the multi-scale computational penalty while preserving microstructural fidelity. The proposed framework shows potential for multiphysics structural assessments and safety margin evaluations of core internals over operational lifespans.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于5D插值表和泰勒级数线性化的多尺度框架，将多晶塑性模型（VPSC）高效集成到宏观有限元求解器Code_Aster中，在保证微结构精度的同时显著降低了核反应堆锆合金部件的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 锆合金堆芯构件（如定位格架、燃料包壳）在辐照蠕变和生长耦合作用下发生各向异性尺寸变化。微力学晶体塑性框架（如VPSC）虽能捕捉这些微结构驱动的现象，但其与宏观有限元求解器的集成在工程尺度计算中计算代价过高，亟需一种兼顾精度与效率的多尺度方法。
AI.method: 在开源FEM求解器Code_Aster中实现多尺度框架：1) 采用5D插值表（IT）作为静态材料代理，控制瞬时粘塑性响应；2) 结合周期性重校准和一阶泰勒级数线性化方案，追踪辐照损伤引起的微结构漂移，避免在线数据库更新。该Polycrystal Yield Surface (PCYS)插值方法通过与VPSC-FEM联合仿真在连续高剂量辐照场景下进行基准测试。
AI.result: 材料级评估表明，线性化方案在代表性变形路径上将相对误差限制在1%以下，保持结构兼容性。定位格架域的结构仿真实现了有意义的计算节省，克服了多尺度计算代价，同时保持了微结构保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在堆芯内部构件运行寿命内的多物理场结构评估和安全裕度评价中具有应用潜力。

title: Helium Ground State Treated in Classical Physics with Classical Zero-Point Radiation
summary: The ground state of the helium atom is considered within classical electrodynamics which includes classical electromagnetic zero-point radiation. Approximate energy balance between energy loss through emitted radiation and energy gain from classical zero-point radiation is found when the two electrons are treated as charges located on opposite ends of a diameter of a common circular orbit around the nucleus. The classical result gives approximately the same value as that given by the quantum calculation, but is a different value.

AI.tldr: 本文在包含经典电磁零点辐射的经典电动力学框架下研究氦原子基态，发现当两个电子位于绕核共圆轨道直径两端时，辐射能量损失与零点辐射能量增益达到近似平衡，所得经典结果与量子计算结果数值相近但不同。
AI.motivation: 探索经典电动力学（含零点辐射）能否描述氦原子基态，挑战量子力学对原子结构的唯一解释地位。
AI.method: 将两个电子视为位于绕核共同圆形轨道直径两端的点电荷，在经典电动力学框架下计算辐射能量损失与经典电磁零点辐射能量增益，寻找能量平衡条件。
AI.result: 在该经典模型下，辐射损失与零点辐射增益达到近似能量平衡，所得基态能量值与量子力学计算结果数值相近但不完全相同。
AI.conclusion: 经典电动力学（含零点辐射）可近似得到氦原子基态能量，但值与量子计算结果存在差异，说明经典模型虽能逼近但无法完全替代量子力学描述。

title: Beam-Level Nonlinear Compton Spectra via a Neural Network Surrogate Model
summary: Nonlinear Compton scattering enables sources of intense high-energy radiation. However, predicting source-level spectra for realistic electron beams typically requires computationally expensive trajectory-based calculations, whereas existing analytical models for spectral envelopes are limited to a restricted range of laser pulse parameters. Here, we demonstrate that, for electron beams with sufficiently broad phase-space distributions, beam-level nonlinear Compton spectra can be predicted without lengthy numerical calculations. Our approach combines a fast neural-network surrogate for single-electron spectral envelopes with particle-wise Lorentz transformations. Benchmarked against trajectory-based numerical calculations with thousands of macroparticles, the surrogate reproduces the macroscopic spectral-angular structure while reducing the computational cost by orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合神经网络代理模型与洛伦兹变换的方法，能够快速预测宽相空间分布电子束的非线性康普顿散射谱，相比传统轨道计算方法降低了数个数量级的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 非线性康普顿散射可产生高强度高能辐射，但现有方法中，基于轨道的数值计算成本高昂，而解析模型仅适用于有限激光脉冲参数范围，缺乏高效且通用的预测手段。
AI.method: 将快速神经网络代理模型（用于预测单电子谱包络）与粒子级洛伦兹变换相结合，对相空间分布足够宽的电子束进行束级非线性康普顿谱预测。
AI.result: 以数千宏粒子的轨道数值计算为基准，该代理模型在复现宏观谱-角结构的同时，将计算成本降低了数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在无需冗长数值计算的前提下，准确预测宽相空间分布电子束的束级非线性康普顿谱，大幅提升计算效率。

title: Semi-analytical model for the rising sheet generated by droplet-pair impact
summary: When two low-Ohnesorge-number drops impact a dry substrate simultaneously, their spreading lamellae collide and lift a free-standing vertical sheet. The sheet grows by inertial feeding from the spreading drops and is pulled back by capillary retraction at its rim. We develop a semi-analytical model for this rising sheet by extending the single-drop impact description of~\citet{Gordillo2019} to the two-drop geometry. The thin-film flow in the sheet is coupled at its base to the colliding lamellae and at its apex to a capillary-retarded rim. The sheet interior is then solved along ballistic characteristics in two stages: a lamella-fed stage, for which the velocity and thickness fields can be obtained in closed form, and a post-lamella stage, for which the inlet conditions are taken from simulations. The resulting framework gives the three-dimensional velocity and thickness fields and therefore the full sheet shape. On the centreline, the apex height and local thickness are obtained explicitly, showing that the different Weber-number exponents reported in the literature arise from a crossover rather than from a single universal scaling law. At sufficiently large Weber number, the apex pinches off. A linear Rayleigh--Plateau analysis, using the time-dependent jet diameter and deceleration predicted by the model, then bounds the maximum attainable height and closes the description of the pinch-off regime.

AI.tldr: 本文针对两滴低Ohnesorge数液滴同时撞击干燥基底时产生的自由站立垂直液膜，提出了一种半解析模型。该模型将单液滴撞击的描述扩展至双液滴几何，结合弹道特征求解液膜内部流场，并通过中心线上的解析解揭示了不同Weber数指数来源于交叉而非单一标度律，同时对高Weber数下的夹断行为进行了Rayleigh–Plateau稳定性分析。
AI.motivation: 理解双液滴同时撞击时垂直液膜的动力学行为，特别是液膜生长与毛细回缩的竞争机制，以及不同Weber数下液膜高度的标度律来源。
AI.method: 将Gordillo等人(2019)的单液滴撞击模型扩展至双液滴几何；将液膜薄层流动与底部碰撞展延的lamella及顶部毛细回缩边缘耦合；沿弹道特征分两阶段（lamella喂养阶段和后lamella阶段）求解速度与厚度场；采用线性Rayleigh–Plateau不稳定性分析夹断行为。
AI.result: 获得了液膜的三维速度、厚度场及完整形状；中心线上得到液膜顶点高度与局部厚度的显式解析解；发现不同Weber数指数源于标度律的交叉而非单一普适标度；通过稳定性分析给出了最大可达高度与夹断界限。
AI.conclusion: 该模型统一描述了双液滴碰撞产生的垂直液膜从生长到夹断的完整过程，澄清了文献中关于Weber数指数的争议，并为预测液膜最大高度提供了理论界限。

title: RF Helicon Plasma Thruster for an Atmosphere-Breathing Electric Propulsion System (ABEP)
summary:
This dissertation focuses on Atmosphere-Breathing Electric Propulsion (ABEP) for propellant-less continuous orbiting in very low Earth orbits (VLEO) and very low Mars orbits (VLMO). ABEP utilizes an intake to collect atmospheric particles as propellant for an electric thruster, offsetting aerodynamic drag. An analytical system-level analysis assesses collectible mass flow, drag, and power requirements, using GOCE as a case study.
  Three intake designs are developed based on gas-surface interactions. Two diffuse-reflection designs yield collection efficiencies $η_c < 0.5$, while a specular-reflection design achieves $η_c < 0.95$. The specular intake demonstrates superior robustness against flow misalignment, maintaining high efficiency at large angles.
  The proposed ABEP thruster features a contactless, neutralizer-free design using a helicon plasma discharge, preventing erosion from aggressive species like atomic oxygen. Numerical simulations via the HELIC code determined key design parameters (frequency, magnetic field, plasma density), leading to the implementation of a resonant birdcage antenna with high electrical efficiency.
  The thruster was manufactured and experimentally validated using Ar, N_2, and O_2. Tests demonstrated successful ignition and operation across relevant mass flows with low power consumption ($P_f < 60$ W). Additionally, a B-dot probe was developed to detect helicon waves in the plasma plume.
  Ultimately, this work delivers verified intake designs and a novel contactless plasma thruster with high electrical efficiency (>99% in vacuum). Both components represent promising technologies for near-future ABEP applications. Future development outlooks, diagnostics, and spacecraft configurations are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕吸气式电推进（ABEP）技术展开研究，旨在实现极低地球轨道（VLEO）和极低火星轨道（VLMO）上无需携带推进剂的连续在轨飞行。通过解析系统级分析评估了可收集质量流量、气动阻力和功率需求，并以GOCE卫星为案例。开发了三种基于气体-表面相互作用的进气口设计：两种漫反射设计的收集效率η_c < 0.5，而镜面反射设计实现了η_c < 0.95，且对来流偏转具有良好鲁棒性。提出了一种非接触式、无需中和技术的中性器设计，采用螺旋波等离子体放电，避免原子氧等侵蚀性物种的腐蚀。利用HELIC代码进行数值模拟确定关键设计参数，实现了高电效率的谐振鸟笼天线。对推进器进行了制造并利用Ar、N₂和O₂进行实验验证，成功在相关质量流量下点火运行，功耗低于60 W。此外，开发了B-dot探针以检测羽流中的螺旋波。最终，本文提供了经过验证的进气口设计和一种新型非接触式等离子体推进器，真空电效率超过99%，是近期ABEP应用的可行技术。
AI.motivation: 传统卫星在极低轨道运行时面临巨大气动阻力，需携带大量推进剂进行轨道维持，任务寿命受限。ABEP技术可通过收集稀薄大气作为推进剂，实现无需携带推进剂的连续轨道维持，显著提升VLEO和VLMO任务的经济性和持久性。现有ABEP方案存在进气口效率低、推进器电极受原子氧侵蚀等问题，亟需新的设计方案。
AI.method: 采用解析系统级分析方法评估质量流量、阻力和功率需求；基于气体-表面相互作用开发三种进气口设计（两种漫反射、一种镜面反射）；利用HELIC数值模拟确定等离子体推进器参数，设计谐振鸟笼天线；制造推进器样机并使用Ar、N₂、O₂进行实验验证；开发B-dot探针诊断等离子体羽流中的螺旋波。
AI.result: 漫反射进气口收集效率η_c < 0.5，镜面反射进气口η_c < 0.95且对来流偏转鲁棒性好；推进器在Ar、N₂、O₂气氛下成功点火运行，功耗Pf < 60 W；真空电效率>99%；B-dot探针成功检测到螺旋波信号。
AI.conclusion: 本文验证了镜面反射进气口和高电效率非接触式螺旋波等离子体推进器作为ABEP关键组件的技术可行性，两者均为近期ABEP应用提供了有前景的技术方案。未来需进一步开展系统诊断和航天器构型优化等工作。

title: Ultrafast Third-Harmonic Spectral Modulation and Self-Action in Resonant Nonlocal Metasurfaces
summary: Quasi-bound states in the continuum enable exceptional field confinement, strongly reducing the pump intensity threshold for nonlinear light-matter interaction in dielectric metasurfaces. As a result, nonlinear self-action effects, often elusive in bulk nonlinear media, emerge at moderate excitation intensities. Here, we show how pulse duration and resonant coupling govern the nonlinear self-action mechanism in resonantly enhanced third-harmonic (TH) generation from a nonlocal metasurface. We identify two excitation regimes that interact differently with the resonant mode, revealing complementary intensity-dependent responses. Under spectrally narrow picosecond excitation, resonance-enhanced TH generation shows pronounced deviations from cubic scaling at high intensities. In contrast, broadband femtosecond excitation transiently drives the resonance, encoding the nonlinear response in the spectral reshaping and broadening of the TH signal. Simulations reproduce both regimes: continuous-wave modeling captures picosecond power scaling and higher-harmonic interactions, while time-domain simulations resolve femtosecond dynamics. These results clarify nonlinear self-action in metasurfaces featuring quasi-bound states in the continuum, linking strong field confinement to conversion efficiency, scaling behavior, and distinct spectral dynamics under different excitation conditions. This work sheds light on the interplay between pulse duration, bandwidth, and resonant coupling in high-Q nonlocal dielectric metasurfaces, advancing their use in ultrafast and nonlinear nanophotonics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非局域介质超表面中准连续谱束缚态（quasi-BIC）激发的非线性自作用机制，揭示了脉冲宽度和谐振耦合如何调控三次谐波（TH）产生过程。皮秒激发下，谐振增强的TH表现出偏离三次方标度的强度依赖；飞秒激发则通过瞬态驱动谐振，将非线性响应编码在TH信号的频谱重塑和展宽中。
AI.motivation: 准连续谱束缚态能够实现极强的场局域，大幅降低电介质超表面中非线性光-物质相互作用的泵浦强度阈值，使得在块体非线性介质中难以观测的非线性自作用效应在中等激发强度下即可显现。作者旨在阐明脉冲宽度、带宽与谐振耦合如何调控这类系统中的非线性自作用机制。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的建模方式：连续波（CW）建模用于捕捉皮秒功率标度和高阶谐波相互作用；时域模拟用于解析飞秒动力学。通过对比窄带皮秒激发和宽带飞秒激发两种机制，研究谐振增强三次谐波产生的非线性响应。
AI.result: 皮秒激发下，谐振增强的TH产生在高强度下表现出偏离三次方标度的显著偏差；飞秒激发则瞬态驱动谐振模式，将非线性响应体现为TH信号的频谱重塑和展宽。
AI.conclusion: 该工作阐明了具有准BIC的介质超表面中的非线性自作用机制，将强场局域与转换效率、标度行为以及不同激发条件下的独特频谱动力学联系起来，推进了此类结构在超快和非线性纳米光子学中的应用。

title: dpti: An Automated Thermodynamic Integration Workflow for Phase Diagram Calculations with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Thermodynamic integration (TI) is a widely used approach for computing free energies and phase diagrams. However, TI calculations driven by machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) remain technically challenging because they require careful design of reversible integration paths and many closely related molecular dynamics (MD) tasks for each phase and state point. To address these challenges, we present dpti, an open-source Python package that automates TI workflows for phase diagram calculations with MLIPs. dpti connects reference systems with analytically known free energies to MLIP-described atomic and molecular solids and liquids through reversible integration paths. Given JSON input files, dpti generates and runs the required MD tasks, computes free energy contributions, estimates errors, and propagates coexistence points into phase boundaries. We demonstrate the usage of dpti with two examples driven by Deep Potential models: a silica phase diagram involving beta-quartz, coesite, and melt, and the ice Ih-liquid water phase boundary. dpti provides a useful tool for automated phase diagram calculations of materials modeled by MLIPs.

AI.tldr: dpti是一个开源的Python包，用于自动化机器学习原子间势（MLIP）驱动的热力学积分（TI）工作流，实现相图计算。它通过可逆积分路径连接参考体系与MLIP描述的体系，自动生成和执行分子动力学任务，计算自由能贡献并传播共存点。在二氧化硅（β-石英、柯石英、熔体）和冰Ih-液态水相边界上展示了应用。
AI.motivation: MLIP驱动的热力学积分计算在技术上具有挑战性，需要精心设计可逆积分路径以及为每个相和状态点执行大量密切相关的分子动力学任务，因此亟需自动化工具来简化这一流程。
AI.method: dpti通过将具有解析自由能的参考体系与MLIP描述的体系通过可逆积分路径连接，接收JSON输入文件，自动生成并运行所需分子动力学任务，计算自由能贡献，估计误差，并将共存点传播为相边界。
AI.result: 通过Deep Potential模型驱动的两个示例验证：二氧化硅相图（β-石英、柯石英和熔体）以及冰Ih-液态水相边界，展示了dpti的有效性。
AI.conclusion: dpti为基于MLIP描述的材料提供了自动化的相图计算工具，解决了热力学积分工作流中的技术挑战。

title: Reconfigurable Bitter-Type Electromagnet for Zeeman Slowing
summary: Many Zeeman slower magnets are geometrically captured by a vacuum chamber, preventing modification or repair without breaking vacuum. We describe a Bitter-type electromagnet coil design that can be easily disassembled, reconfigured, repaired, and replaced without disturbing the vacuum system. This coil, designed to slow lithium atoms, produces a near-ideal field profile with a single DC power supply. With a resistance of 5.7(9) m$Ω$, an inductance of 8.8(2) $μ$H, and switching times as low as $\sim100$ $μ$s, the coil compares favorably to other designs, and can be disassembled, modified, and reassembled repeatedly without loss of performance. With forced-air cooling, the coil experiences moderate heating. This coil design offers greater flexibility than traditional electromagnet designs, and it can retrofitted onto existing UHV chambers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可拆卸、可重构、易维护的Bitter型电磁线圈设计，用于塞曼减速器，能在不破坏真空系统的条件下进行修改或维修，并展示了其在锂原子减速中的优异性能。
AI.motivation: 传统塞曼减速器磁铁被真空室几何结构束缚，无法在不破坏真空的条件下进行修改或维修，因此需要一种可轻松拆卸、重新配置、修复和更换的线圈设计。
AI.method: 采用Bitter型电磁线圈设计，该线圈可拆卸、可重构，通过单个直流电源产生近乎理想的磁场分布，并通过强制风冷进行散热。
AI.result: 线圈电阻5.7(9) mΩ，电感8.8(2) μH，开关时间低至约100 μs，可反复拆卸组装而不损失性能，强制风冷下温度升高适中。
AI.conclusion: 该Bitter型线圈设计比传统电磁铁设计具有更大的灵活性，可改装到现有超高真空腔体上，适用于需要频繁调整或维护的塞曼减速器场景。

title: Beam-excited resonant modes in RF cavities
summary: Beam-excited resonant modes in RF cavities are important sources of beam-coupling impedance and coupled-bunch instabilities in high-current storage rings. We develop a unified framework for longitudinal and transverse resonant impedances based on Maxwell's equations and generalized cavity-voltage definitions, and derive analytical expressions for impedances obtained from finite-length truncated wakefields. The formulation enables the resonant frequencies, normalized longitudinal and transverse shunt impedances, and, when sufficiently constrained, the quality factors to be extracted from practical wakefield simulations without requiring fully converged long-range wakes. The method is validated with an axisymmetric pillbox cavity through comparison with analytical results and eigenmode calculations. It is then applied to the RF cavity of the Storage-Ring-based Coherent Light Source (SRCLS), where the extracted HOM parameters are used to reconstruct total impedance spectra, evaluate coupled-bunch instability thresholds, and guide cavity-geometry optimization. The results demonstrate an efficient connection between wakefield analysis, eigenmode characterization, and beam-stability evaluation for practical RF-cavity designs.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了基于麦克斯韦方程和广义腔压定义的纵向与横向谐振阻抗统一框架，推导了有限长截断尾场中阻抗的解析表达式，使谐振频率、归一化 shunt 阻抗及品质因数可从非完全收敛的尾场模拟中提取。通过轴对称柱形腔验证后，将该方法应用于 SRCLS 的 RF 腔，提取高阶模参数用于重建阻抗谱、评估束团不稳定性阈值并指导腔体几何优化。
AI.motivation: 高电流储存环中，束流激发的谐振模式是束流耦合阻抗和耦合束团不稳定性的重要来源，需要高效且精确地从尾场模拟中提取这些参数，避免完全收敛长程尾场带来的高昂计算成本。
AI.method: 基于麦克斯韦方程和广义腔压定义，建立纵向/横向谐振阻抗统一框架；推导有限长截断尾场的阻抗解析表达式，实现从非完全收敛的短程尾场中提取谐振频率、归一化 shunt 阻抗及品质因数。
AI.result: 通过轴对称柱形腔的解析解和本征模计算验证了方法的准确性；成功应用于 SRCLS 射频腔，提取的高阶模参数重建了总阻抗谱，评估了耦合束团不稳定性阈值，并指导了腔体几何优化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在尾场分析、本征模表征和束流稳定性评估之间建立了高效连接，为实际射频腔设计提供了实用工具。

title: Two-way coupling in active suspensions suppresses particle accumulation and induces non-monotonic flow stabilization
summary: We experimentally study the two-way coupling between a swarm of centimetre-scale active swimmers (Artemia salina) and an electromagnetically driven quasi-two-dimensional cellular flow. The swimmer loading $N$ and the background forcing $E$ are varied independently across 85 conditions, and the coupled dynamics are characterized through Lagrangian diagnostics built on the attracting Lagrangian coherent structures (LCS) of the flow. In the dilute limit, swimmers accumulate onto the attracting LCS most strongly when their speed is comparable to the flow speed, recovering the mobility-selective accumulation predicted by one-way-coupled simulations at the fixed aspect ratio of A. salina. As the loading increases, this accumulation is progressively suppressed, a collective effect inaccessible to single-swimmer models. The back-action of the swarm on the flow is itself bidirectional and regime-dependent: at low forcing the swarm disorders the attracting-LCS web and scatters the topological critical points of the cellular pattern, whereas at high forcing it reorganizes and reinforces the skeleton. The temporal stability of the skeleton is correspondingly non-monotonic in both $N$ and $E$, with the conditions of maximal stability migrating systematically through the $(N,E)$ plane. This reinforcement of coherent structures has no counterpart in prior simulations, which reported a predominantly disruptive back-action. Resolving both directions of the coupling shows how collective activity can either erode or reinforce the transport skeleton of a structured flow.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究了厘米级活性游泳者（卤虫）与电磁驱动准二维涡旋流之间的双向耦合，发现游泳者加载量N和背景强迫E独立变化于85种条件下。稀极限下，游泳者速度与流速相当时会强烈聚集到吸引性拉格朗日相干结构（LCS）上；随着加载量增加，这种聚集被抑制。种群对流的反作用双向且依赖状态：低强迫下种群扰乱LCS网络并散射拓扑临界点，高强迫下则重组并强化骨架。时间稳定性在N和E上呈非单调变化，最大稳定条件在(N,E)平面中系统迁移。这种相干结构的强化在以往模拟中未见。
AI.motivation: 现有单向耦合模型无法捕捉活性游泳者与流动之间的完整双向耦合效应，尤其是种群集体行为对流动结构的反馈机制尚未被实验揭示。以往模拟主要报告破坏性反作用，但真实系统中可能存在强化效应，需要实验验证。
AI.method: 实验采用厘米级活性游泳者（卤虫）与电磁驱动准二维涡旋流系统，独立变化游泳者加载量N和背景强迫E共85种条件，通过基于吸引性拉格朗日相干结构（LCS）的拉格朗日诊断量表征耦合动力学。
AI.result: 稀极限下游泳者速度与流速相当时积累最强，恢复单向耦合预测；高加载抑制积累。低强迫下种群扰乱LCS并散射临界点，高强迫下重组强化骨架。时间稳定性在N和E上非单调，最大稳定条件迁移。
AI.conclusion: 集体活动可以根据流动参数不同，要么侵蚀要么强化结构化流动的输运骨架，这种强化效应是单向耦合模拟未曾预测的新现象，揭示了双向耦合中反作用方向的复杂性。

title: Runaway electron induced explosions of graphite; modeling versus controlled DIII-D experiments
summary: The state-of-the-art concerning the modeling of the thermomechanical response of graphite to runaway electron (RE) impact is based on one-way coupled linear thermoelasticity combined with Rankine's strength-based failure criterion and limited to the onset of material failure. Here, the predictive capabilities are extended to the nonlinear damage phase characterized by material fragmentation and debris expulsion. This is achieved by introducing plasticity via the Johnson-Holmquist constitutive model, adopting an effective plastic strain-based failure criterion and coupling finite element analysis with smoothed-particle hydrodynamics. The extended thermomechanical model is successfully benchmarked against the results of two controlled RE-induced damage experiments recently carried out in DIII-D. This constitutes an important step towards the final objective of quantitatively describing the thermomechanical response of tungsten to REs.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Johnson-Holmquist塑性模型和有效塑性应变失效准则，结合有限元与光滑粒子流体动力学耦合方法，将石墨在失控电子冲击下的热-力学响应建模从线性弹性破坏阶段扩展到非线性损伤（材料碎裂与碎片抛射）阶段，并在DIII-D实验中得到验证，为最终定量描述钨材料的热-力学响应迈出重要一步。
AI.motivation: 现有石墨在失控电子冲击下的热-力学响应模型局限于单向耦合线性热弹性理论及Rankine强度失效准则，仅能预测材料失效的起始阶段，无法描述后续的非线性损伤行为（如材料碎裂和碎片抛射），亟需拓展建模能力以覆盖完整失效过程。
AI.method: 引入Johnson-Holmquist本构模型实现塑性描述，采用基于有效塑性应变的失效准则，并将有限元分析与光滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）耦合，实现从连续介质到离散碎片演化的模拟。
AI.result: 扩展后的热-力学模型成功通过了DIII-D装置上两项受控失控电子诱导损伤实验的基准验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为最终实现定量描述钨材料在失控电子冲击下热-力学响应的目标迈出了重要一步。

title: Ultrafast All-Optical Polarization Control via Symmetry Breaking in an Au Nanorod Dimer Metamaterial
summary: The continuous evolution of ultrafast optical technologies requires advanced solutions for the dynamic and selective manipulation of light's degrees of freedom. While metamaterials excel at tailoring these properties through static geometrical design, achieving sub-picosecond, all-optical dynamic control without sacrificing signal throughput remains a fundamental challenge. Here, an Au orthogonal nanorod dimer plasmonic metasurface capable of ultrafast, transmissive control over the ellipticity, and optical rotation of light is presented. By exploiting the transient optical nonlinearity of Au under femtosecond excitation, hot-electron generation can be selectively induced in either nanorod by leveraging the pronounced geometric anisotropy of the unit cell. The transient response is captured by coupling a Three-Temperature Model (3TM) with Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) simulations. This ultrafast response is driven by non-thermal electron excitation, rapid electron-electron thermalization, and subsequent lattice heating, which dynamically break the optical symmetry of the orthogonal localized surface plasmon (LSP) modes supported by the dimers. Crucially, this active mode-mixing drives sub-picosecond polarization switching, reaching peak shifts of approximately 10 degrees in ellipticity and up to approximately 20 degrees in optical rotation with an instantaneous response and a relaxation time of approximately 3 ps, while the absolute amplitude of the transmitted signal is only weakly perturbed. By achieving macroscopic transmissive polarization shifts alongside a highly stable 40% transmission efficiency, this platform overcomes the severe optical attenuation and geometric constraints that bottleneck existing nonlinear architectures, paving the way for low-latency, high-speed optical switches and modulators essential for next-generation nanophotonic networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于金正交纳米棒二聚体等离激元超表面的器件，通过飞秒激光激发诱导热电子，实现亚皮秒时间尺度的透射式椭圆率和光学旋转动态调控，峰值变化分别达到约10度和约20度，透射效率稳定在40%，为超快光开关和调制器提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: 超快光学技术需要动态且选择性地操控光的自由度，但现有超表面主要实现静态调控，缺乏能在亚皮秒时间尺度实现全光动态控制且不牺牲信号通量的解决方案。
AI.method: 设计Au正交纳米棒二聚体等离激元超表面，利用飞秒激发下Au的光学非线性，通过单元结构的几何各向异性选择性诱导单根纳米棒中的热电子产生；结合三温度模型(3TM)和时域有限差分(FDTD)仿真捕获瞬态响应。
AI.result: 实现了亚皮秒偏振切换，椭圆率峰值偏移约10度，光学旋转峰值偏移约20度，瞬时响应且弛豫时间约3 ps，透射信号幅度仅受微弱扰动，透射效率稳定在40%。
AI.conclusion: 该平台克服了现有非线性架构的光学衰减和几何限制问题，为下一代纳米光子网络中的低延迟、高速光开关和调制器铺平了道路。

title: Watts per event: evaluating Sustainability of HEP Event Generators beyond the LHC era
summary: The development, tuning and operation of Monte Carlo event generators beyond the LHC era require vast amount of resources. In this study we investigate the sustainability of these software with a containerized set of tools (named 77rev/propripy), by benchmarking the HIJING++ heavy-ion Monte Carlo event generator. We analyze the performance of various CPU architectures and show that by choosing the level of multithreading properly, the cost of event generation can be optimized. The presented approach can reduce the energy footprint of high-energy physics event generators and therefore alleviate the ever-increasing, ubiquitous computational challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过容器化工具集77rev/propripy对HIJING++重离子蒙特卡洛事件生成器进行基准测试，分析了不同CPU架构的性能，发现合理选择多线程级别可以优化事件生成成本，从而降低高能物理事件生成器的能耗足迹，缓解计算挑战。
AI.motivation: LHC后时代蒙特卡洛事件生成器的开发、调优和运行需要大量资源，因此研究这些软件的可持续性至关重要。
AI.method: 使用容器化工具集77rev/propripy对HIJING++重离子蒙特卡洛事件生成器进行基准测试，分析不同CPU架构的性能，并研究多线程级别对事件生成成本的影响。
AI.result: 通过合理选择多线程级别，可以优化事件生成的成本。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法可以降低高能物理事件生成器的能耗足迹，从而缓解日益增长的计算挑战。

title: Calculation of the energy levels and hyperfine structure for Xe~II, Rn~II, and Og~II ions
summary: Energy levels, Landé $g$-factors, and hyperfine-structure constants are calculated for the singly ionized noble-gas atoms Xe II, Rn II, and Og II. The calculations are performed using the configuration-interaction method with perturbative treatment of high-lying configurations. Core polarization effects in the hyperfine interaction are included within the time-dependent Hartree-Fock method. Calculations for Xe II are used to test the accuracy of the approach by comparison with available experimental data. The agreement is at the level of about one percent for the energies and typically about ten percent for the hyperfine constants, with better accuracy for states with large hyperfine constants. Predictions are then presented for Rn II and Og II, for which experimental spectroscopic data are limited or absent. Special attention is paid to Breit and quantum-electrodynamic corrections to the hyperfine structure in heavy many-electron ions. We show that these corrections may be strongly enhanced by configuration mixing when interacting states with very different hyperfine matrix elements are separated by small energy intervals. This effect is demonstrated explicitly for odd-parity $J=1/2$ states of Og II. The calculated hyperfine-structure constants for Rn II and Og II provide electronic factors needed for extracting nuclear magnetic dipole and electric quadrupole moments from future spectroscopic measurements. These results may be useful for experimental studies of radon and oganesson ions and for testing nuclear models in the superheavy region.

AI.tldr: 本文采用CI+PT方法计算了Xe II、Rn II和Og II的能级、Landé g因子和超精细结构常数，重点预测了缺乏实验数据的Rn II和Og II，并揭示了Breit和QED修正可能因组态混合而显著增强的现象。
AI.motivation: Rn II和Og II等重离子在实验上缺乏或没有光谱数据，尤其超重元素Og的超精细结构研究几乎空白。为提取核磁偶极矩和电四极矩以及检验超重区核模型，需要可靠的理论预测。
AI.method: 采用组态相互作用（CI）方法结合高激发组态的微扰处理，超精细相互作用中的核极化效应通过含时Hartree-Fock（TDHF）方法纳入，同时考虑了Breit和量子电动力学（QED）修正对超精细结构的影响。
AI.result: Xe II的计算与实验对比：能量精度约1%，超精细常数精度约10%（较大超精细常数的态精度更好）。预测了Rn II和Og II的相关参数，并发现当相互作用态的超精细矩阵元差异大且能级间隔小时，Breit和QED修正会被组态混合强烈增强，在Og II的奇宇称J=1/2态中明确展示。
AI.conclusion: 计算结果为Rn II和Og II提供了提取核矩所需的电子因子，对超重离子的实验研究和核模型检验具有重要参考价值。

title: Quasi mono-energetic, relativistic electron acceleration in a femtosecond, high intensity laser excited solid magnet
summary: The interaction of ultraintense lasers with magnetized overdense plasmas reveals a fundamentally new regime of laser-driven particle acceleration. Particle-in-cell simulations demonstrate the generation of directional, quasi-monoenergetic electrons in the MeV energy range superimposed on a broad thermal electron background with the estimated acceleration gradient of 3.6 MeV/μm, which is the highest till date. In contrast to conventional laser-plasma accelerators, which rely on underdense plasmas and are therefore constrained to relatively low plasma densities and limited beam charge, the present scheme operates in plasmas with densities orders of magnitude higher, opening new possibilities for the generation of high-flux energetic electron beams. A central result of this work is the demonstration of the excitation of electron Bernstein waves during relativistic laser interaction with magnetized overdense plasmas. The subsequent Landau damping of these electrostatic warm-plasma modes selectively transfers energy to resonant electrons, leading to the emergence of quasi-monoenergetic spectral peaks at energies that can be tuned through the applied magnetic field. To support the simulation results, we experimentally demonstrate the directional emission of energetic electrons from a simple permanent-magnet target irradiated by an ultraintense laser pulse, highlighting the practical feasibility of controlled electron-beam generation in dense plasma environments. These findings establish electron Bernstein waves as an efficient mediator of laser energy coupling in overdense plasmas and introduce a new paradigm for controlled particle acceleration and energy deposition in high-energy-density plasma systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于磁化过稠等离子体中电子伯恩斯坦波激发的新激光粒子加速机制，通过PIC模拟展示了3.6 MeV/μm的超高加速梯度及准单能电子束产生，并实验验证了其可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统激光等离子体加速器依赖欠稠等离子体，受限于低等离子体密度和有限束电荷量；本文旨在探索在密度高出数个量级的过稠等离子体中实现高流强、准单能电子束产生的新方案。
AI.method: 利用粒子模拟（PIC）研究超强激光与磁化过稠等离子体相互作用，分析电子伯恩斯坦波的激发及其朗道阻尼对共振电子的能量选择性转移；同时采用永磁体靶进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在MeV能量范围内产生了定向、准单能电子束叠加在宽热电子背景上，加速梯度达到3.6 MeV/μm（迄今为止最高值）；实验证实了定向高能电子发射的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 电子伯恩斯坦波是过稠等离子体中激光能量耦合的高效介质，可通过外加磁场调控电子能量峰值，开辟了高能量密度等离子体系统中可控粒子加速与能量沉积的新范式。

title: The Excess Dissipation of Energy in a Turbulent Boundary-Layer and its Departure from Log-Normality
summary: We investigate turbulent dissipation in a von Karman flow using PIV and Diffusing Wave Spectroscopy measurements to directly compare bulk and wall dynamics. While bulk dissipation conforms to the dissipative anomaly, wall dissipation exhibits a clear excess that grows with Re, consistent with velocity-gradient dominated scaling. Decomposition into dissipation intensity bands reveals that this excess is mainly driven by progressive redistribution toward high-intensity events, larger than 10 x mean, as Re increases. From these measurements, we infer the skin-friction coefficient, finding a decreasing trend with Re fairly consistent with classical power-law behavior despite increasing dissipation. Statistically, the wall shows strong departures from log-normality at low Re that diminishes with increasing Re, reflecting an increase in the effective dimensionality of the near-wall gradient field with Re. In contrast, the bulk dissipation remains near log-normal across all Re with slowly growing log-dissipation variance, consistent with K62 refined similarity. These results suggest distinct origins of log-normal behavior which are multiplicative cascade dynamics in the bulk versus the combined effect of persistent shear and a superposition of an increasing number of independent gradient contributions at the wall.

AI.tldr: 利用PIV和扩散波谱测量法研究von Karman流动中的湍流耗散，发现体相耗散符合耗散异常，而壁面耗散存在随Re增长的过量，主要由高强度事件重新分布驱动。由此推断的壁面摩擦系数符合经典幂律趋势。壁面显著偏离对数正态分布且随Re增加而减小，体相约对数正态，暗示两者对数正态行为的不同起源。
AI.motivation: 探究von Karman流动中体相与壁面湍流耗散的差异及其物理机制，厘清耗散异常的适用范围，并揭示壁面摩擦系数与耗散增长之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用PIV（粒子图像测速）和DWS（扩散波谱测量）分别测量体相和壁面的湍流耗散，通过耗散强度带分解分析事件分布，并推断壁面摩擦系数及统计分布特性（对数正态拟合、有效维度分析）。
AI.result: 体相耗散符合耗散异常，壁面耗散存在过量且随Re增长；过量由高强度事件（>10倍均值）再分布驱动；壁面摩擦系数随Re递减符合经典幂律；壁面低Re时显著偏离对数正态，随Re增加偏离减小；体相耗散在所有Re下接近对数正态。
AI.conclusion: 体相与壁面尽管都表现出耗散随Re增长，但物理机制不同：体相源于多级级联动力学（K62），壁面源于持续剪切与独立梯度贡献叠加效应，两者对数正态行为的起源有本质区别。

title: Production of high-quality plasma discharges via real-time control of plasma current ramp-up using neutral gas injection in Aditya-U tokamak
summary: Robust control of plasma current ramp-up is an absolute necessity, as an efficient and uncontaminated plasma current ramp-up is essential for achieving prolonged, high-pressure tokamak plasma discharges. In conventional tokamaks with Ohmic breakdown, the plasma current ramp-up is achieved primarily with pre-fixed temporal profiles of the applied toroidal electric field and the equilibrium magnetic field (Bv). The pre-fixed temporal profiles of these fields are often insufficient to maintain a successful plasma current ramp-up, as several unquantified dynamical variables, such as the condition of the vessel wall and plasma-facing components, influence the plasma current rise. Fuel gas injection in an appropriate quantity at a suitable time during the current ramp-up is therefore used to control the plasma current rise rate, ensuring successful plasma current start-up in Aditya-U. The gas injection time and gas quantity are controlled based on real-time measurement of plasma current rise rate using a digital signal processor (DSP) controller. This special control scheme is capable of achieving the plasma current to rise nearly at the desired rate, resulting in a successful start-up and a stable plasma discharge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于实时等离子体电流上升率测量的燃料气体注入控制方案，用于Aditya-U托卡马克的等离子体电流爬升阶段，通过DSP控制器实时调节注气时间和注气量，使等离子体电流以接近期望速率上升，从而实现成功启动和稳定放电。
AI.motivation: 传统托卡马克中预置的环形电场和平衡磁场时间剖面难以维持成功的等离子体电流爬升，因为壁条件和面向等离子体组件等未定量变量的影响，需要一种鲁棒的控制方法。
AI.method: 基于数字信号处理器(DSP)控制器，实时测量等离子体电流上升率，并据此控制燃料气体的注入时间和注入量。
AI.result: 实现了等离子体电流以接近期望速率上升，获得了成功的启动和稳定的等离子体放电。
AI.conclusion: 该控制方案能够有效应对传统预置剖面方法的不足，为Aditya-U托卡马克等离子体电流爬升提供了鲁棒的控制手段。

title: Avoiding a line-of-sight obstacle via deep sub-Rayleigh shadow-projection utilizing space-time wave packets
summary: A challenge in optics, which is shared by other sources of radiation, is to direct a coherent beam to impinge on a target behind an obstacle intervening in the line-of-sight (LoS). While self-accelerating or bending beams can help avoid an LoS obstacle, the beam does not reach the LoS target downstream beyond the obstacle. If one instead avoids the obstacle by projecting a \textit{transverse} null or shadow onto the axial plane at which it is located, an associated \textit{axial} shadow is cast that extends over the effective Rayleigh length, which reduces the utility of this approach. Unless either the wavelength or the transverse shadow width is changed, this Rayleigh length can only be reduced by modifying the structure of the illumination beam. Here we show that space-time wave packets (STWPs), in which each spatial frequency is tightly associated with a single wavelength, when used as an illumination beam, can dramatically reduce the axial extent of the cast shadow. Indeed, by utilizing STWPs we produce deep sub-Rayleigh-length shadows, in some cases with a more than two orders-of-magnitude reduction below the conventional Rayleigh length. For example, a 5-mm-wide transverse shadow in a Gaussian beam at a wavelength of $\sim1$~$μ$m has a Rayleigh length of $\sim25$~m, whereas the same shadow projected by an STWP extends only $\sim0.15$~m. We demonstrate this sub-Rayleigh-length reduction in the axially cast shadow accompanying transverse nulls whose widths extend over a broad span of widths from 80~$μ$m to 48~mm -- almost three orders-of-magnitude. These results may lead to advances in safe radiation therapy, non-LoS optical and wireless communications, selective stand-off detection, three-dimensional photolithography, and laser ablation and micro-machining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用时空波包（STWPs）作为照明光束，可以大幅减少轴向阴影的瑞利长度，实现了比传统瑞利长度低两个数量级以上的深亚瑞利长度阴影。例如，5mm宽的横向阴影在传统高斯光束中瑞利长度约为25米，而使用STWP后仅延伸约0.15米，实现了超过两个数量级的缩减。
AI.motivation: 传统方法中，为了避开视线（LoS）障碍物，可以通过投射横向零值或阴影到障碍物所在轴向平面，但伴随产生的轴向阴影会延伸超过有效瑞利长度，限制了这一方法的实用性。除非改变波长或横向阴影宽度，否则只能通过修改照明光束结构来缩短瑞利长度。
AI.method: 利用时空波包（STWPs）作为照明光束。STWPs将每个空间频率与单一波长紧密关联，通过这种结构化的照明光束来投影横向零值或阴影，从而大幅缩短轴向阴影的延伸距离。
AI.result: 使用STWPs产生了深亚瑞利长度阴影，在某些情况下比传统瑞利长度降低了两个数量级以上。具体地，5mm宽的横向阴影在传统高斯光束（波长~1μm）中瑞利长度~25m，而STWP投影的相同阴影仅延伸~0.15m。在从80μm到48mm近三个数量级的横向阴影宽度范围内均验证了这种缩减效果。
AI.conclusion: 这些成果可能推动安全放射治疗、非视线光学与无线通信、选择性远距离检测、三维光刻、激光烧蚀与微加工等领域的发展。

title: Robust optical design and closed-form tolerancing through autodiff-based Hessian spectral analysis
summary: Robust optical design demands quantitative knowledge of how manufacturing and alignment tolerances degrade system performance. We show that analysing the perturbation eigenmodes of the Hessian matrix gives qualitative insight about the mechanisms of performance degradation (such as couplings) that is invisible to classical sensitivity-matrix analysis based on the Jacobian alone. Via the envelope theorem, we prove that the first-order sensitivity of the fully compensated system is identical to that of the uncompensated one; refocusing only acts at second order through the Schur complement of the Hessian. We propose the trace of the tolerance-scaled Hessian %,$\Tr(\mathbf{S}\mathbf{H}\mathbf{S})$, as a single scalar robustness metric. Demonstrated on an off-axis three-mirror anastigmat and scaled to a twenty-three-parameter surface-figure model, eigenmode decomposition reveals the dominant sensitivity directions and yields deterministic tolerance budgets that replace costly Monte Carlo sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用Hessian矩阵的微扰本征模分析光学系统鲁棒性，证明了一阶灵敏度在补偿前后不变，并给出容差缩放Hessian迹作为单一鲁棒性度量指标，可替代蒙特卡洛采样生成确定性容差预算。
AI.motivation: 传统基于Jacobian的灵敏度矩阵分析无法揭示性能退化机制（如耦合效应），需要定量理解制造和对准容差如何影响光学系统性能。
AI.method: 分析Hessian矩阵的微扰本征模；利用包络定理证明完全补偿系统与未补偿系统的一阶灵敏度相同，补偿仅在二阶通过Hessian的Schur补起作用；提出容差缩放Hessian的迹Tr(SHS)作为鲁棒性度量。
AI.result: 在离轴三镜消像散系统及23参数面形模型上验证，本征模分解揭示了主导灵敏度方向，生成了确定性容差预算，替代了昂贵的蒙特卡洛采样。
AI.conclusion: Hessian本征模分析能提供Jacobian分析所不可见的定性洞察（如耦合机制），其提出的标量鲁棒性度量和确定性容差方法具有实用价值。

title: Development of a High-Performance Permanent Magnet System for Ion Trapping Experiments
summary: This work presents the design and fabrication of a compact permanent magnet based on an optimized stacked structure of fifteen NdFeB rings. The tunable NS-SN-NS configuration generates a central magnetic field of 0.8T with a reconstructed uniformity of 99.988% within a 1mm radius spherical volume. The remaining field inhomogeneity is dominated by radial dipole components. Requiring neither cryogenics nor external power, this design provides a high-performance and cost-effective alternative to superconducting magnets for applications in ion-trap development and Fourier-transform ion cyclotron resonance mass spectrometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并制造了一种基于15个NdFeB环优化堆叠结构的紧凑型永磁体，采用可调NS-SN-NS配置，在1mm半径球体内产生0.8T中心磁场，均匀度达99.988%，无需低温或外部电源，为离子阱和FT-ICR质谱应用提供了超导磁体的低成本替代方案。
AI.motivation: 开发一种紧凑、低成本、无需低温冷却和外部电源的高性能永磁体，以替代超导磁体在离子阱和傅里叶变换离子回旋共振质谱中的应用。
AI.method: 采用优化堆叠结构的十五个NdFeB环，设计可调的NS-SN-NS配置来产生均匀磁场。
AI.result: 中心磁场强度0.8T，在1mm半径球体内均匀度达99.988%，剩余场不均匀性主要由径向偶极分量主导。
AI.conclusion: 该紧凑永磁体设计无需低温系统和外部电源，为离子阱开发和FT-ICR质谱分析提供了一种高性能、低成本的超导磁体替代方案。

title: An inertial slender-body theory
comment: 41 pages, 23 figures. Submitted to Journal of Fluid Mechanics
summary: We present a fully inertial slender-body theory (SBT) that incorporates the effect of fluid inertia on the scale of the length (the "outer" region) as well as the characteristic diameter (the "inner" region) of a steadily translating slender particle. This is achieved by matching the solution of the quasi-two-dimensional full Navier-Stokes equations in the inner region to an outer solution that consists of a superposition of a solution of the linearized Navier-Stokes equations driven by a line of forces and a potential flow solution driven by a line distribution of sources and source dipoles. The drag and lift forces result from the distribution of Oseen force singularities. These Oseenlets also predominantly govern the torque at small Reynolds numbers and large aspect ratios. However, the potential flow singularities play a crucial role in yielding a torque that grows with increasing Reynolds number at large Reynolds numbers and finite aspect ratios. By comparing the forces and torque on the steadily translating particle with those obtained from a finite difference Navier-Stokes solution, we demonstrate the accuracy of the resulting inertial SBT for $\mathrm{Re}_D$ up to 10, where $\mathrm{Re}_D$ is the Reynolds number based on the smallest dimension, i.e., the characteristic cross-sectional diameter of the slender particle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种完全惯性的细长体理论（SBT），通过匹配内部区域（准二维全Navier-Stokes方程解）和外部区域（线性化Navier-Stokes方程与势流奇点解的叠加），实现了对稳态平移细长粒子在Re_D≤10范围内力与力矩的精确预测。
AI.motivation: 现有细长体理论通常忽略流体惯性效应，或在处理惯性时不够完备。本文旨在发展一种能够同时考虑细长粒子尺度上（外区）和特征直径尺度上（内区）流体惯性的完整惯性SBT，以更准确地预测细长粒子在有限雷诺数下的受力与力矩。
AI.method: 通过匹配渐近展开方法，将内区的准二维全Navier-Stokes方程解与外区的线性化Navier-Stokes方程解（由Oseen力奇点驱动）和势流解（由源偶极子分布驱动）进行匹配。阻力与升力由Oseen力奇点分布主导，力矩则在低Re和大长径比时由Oseenlet主导，而在高Re和有限长径比时势流奇点起关键作用。
AI.result: 通过与有限差分Navier-Stokes数值解的比较，验证了所提出的惯性SBT在Re_D≤10范围内对细长粒子的力与力矩具有较高的预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 发展的完全惯性细长体理论能够有效处理有限雷诺数下的惯性效应，为细长粒子在黏性流体中的动力学分析提供了更准确的理论工具。

title: Particle dynamics and confinement in moving multi-mirror
summary: The moving multi-mirror (MMM) concept mitigates axial losses in magnetic mirrors by using inward-propagating multi-mirror sections to transport escaping particles back toward the central cell. Single-particle simulations are used to establish the underlying dynamics, while a modified rate-equation model provides quantitative estimates of the resulting confinement enhancement. It is found that the steady-state outgoing flux can be robustly suppressed by several orders of magnitude. The analysis uncovered confinement challenges in the MMM concept, indicating that additional scattering processes are required in both the central cell and the MMM sections to achieve the desired confinement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了移动多镜（MMM）概念，通过向内传播的多镜段将逃逸粒子输送回中心电池，从而减轻磁镜中的轴向损失。单粒子模拟建立了基本动力学，改进的速率方程模型提供了约束增强的定量估计。研究发现稳态出射通量可被稳健地抑制几个数量级，但分析揭示了MMM概念中的约束挑战，表明在中心电池和MMM段中都需要额外的散射过程才能实现所需的约束。
AI.motivation: 减轻磁镜聚变装置中轴向粒子损失的问题，提高磁镜系统的约束性能。
AI.method: 采用单粒子模拟建立基本动力学，并使用改进的速率方程模型对约束增强效果进行定量估计。
AI.result: 稳态出射通量可被稳健地抑制几个数量级，但发现MMM概念存在约束挑战，需要额外的散射过程。
AI.conclusion: 移动多镜概念能有效抑制轴向粒子损失，但需要在中心电池和MMM段中引入额外散射过程以实现所需的约束水平。

title: Coupling loss and transmission in a multimode fiber-fed Virtually Imaged Phased Array (VIPA)
summary: The Virtually Imaged Phased Array (VIPA) is a spectral disperser that has seen increasing adoption across various applications, including optical telecommunications, high-resolution spectroscopy, and LiDAR. Although VIPAs are typically fed by single-mode optical fiber in these applications, there is growing interest in using a multimode optical fiber feed to enable higher throughput. However, a multimode fiber feed introduces several challenges, one of which is a fundamental limit on how much light can be coupled into a VIPA. In this work, we derive a closed-form expression for the minimum tilt angle of a multimode fiber-fed VIPA required for no etendue coupling loss, and we show that this angle depends solely on the input fiber's etendue, the focal ratio of the injection cylindrical lens, and the VIPA's intrinsic parameters. Moreover, we derive the 2D and 3D etendue that can be coupled into a VIPA, as well as the VIPA's etendue coupling efficiency and total transmission, given a particular configuration. We validate our mathematical models using ray-tracing simulations in Zemax OpticStudio non-sequential mode. Our results provide practical guidance for the design of high-throughput optical systems based on multimode fiber-fed VIPAs.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了多模光纤馈入虚像相位阵列（VIPA）所需最小倾斜角的闭式表达式，提出无扩展量耦合损耗的条件，并建立了VIPA的扩展量耦合效率与总透过率的数学模型，通过Zemax光线追迹仿真验证了理论分析。
AI.motivation: 多模光纤馈入VIPA虽能提高光通量，但存在扩展量耦合损耗这一根本性限制，现有研究缺乏对该限制的定量描述和设计指导。
AI.method: 推导最小倾斜角的闭式表达式，建立2D和3D扩展量耦合模型，计算耦合效率与总透过率，并使用Zemax OpticStudio非序列模式进行光线追迹仿真验证。
AI.result: 得到了最小倾斜角仅取决于输入光纤扩展量、注入柱面透镜焦比和VIPA本征参数的结论，并验证了所提扩展量耦合效率与总透过率模型的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 为基于多模光纤馈入VIPA的高通量光学系统设计提供了实用指导。

title: Transferable inference of turbulence models for urban flows with the Parameter-Regularised Ensemble Kalman Filter
summary: The accurate simulation of urban flow is key to designing building ventilation, understanding cities' micrometeorology, and predicting pollutant dispersion. Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) simulations are a common modelling approach for simulating urban flow, but their accuracy depends on the closure model and its parameters. These parameters are inferred from benchmark cases, but they are not necessarily suitable for realistic urban environments, which involve different physical mechanisms. This is referred to as the transferability problem of RANS urban modelling. The objective of this work is to propose a robust Bayesian method to {sequentially} infer RANS parameters for urban flow modelling. Key to the approach is the mathematical derivation of the parameter-regularised ensemble Kalman filter (PR-EnKF), which is the analytical solution of the data assimilation problem for the sequential parameter estimation. The cost functional is regularised using the prior knowledge on the turbulence parameters, thereby ensuring that the Bayesian updates remain within physical ranges. The parameters are first inferred on an isolated building, and then transferred to three cases of increasing complexity: (i) a high-rise building, (ii) a multi-building array, and (iii) the Shinjuku district urban environment. Results show that the PR-EnKF achieves faster convergence, reducing parameter uncertainty by an order of magnitude and reconstruction errors by up to 50%. Because of the regularisation, the PR-EnKF selectively updates the most important parameters. This work enables robust large-scale urban flow simulation whilst reducing the computational overhead of model optimisation for urban planning and air quality assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种正则化参数化集成卡尔曼滤波（PR-EnKF）方法，用于顺序推断城市流动RANS模拟的湍流模型参数，解决了参数迁移性问题。该方法在孤立建筑上推断参数，然后迁移至更复杂案例（高层建筑、多建筑阵列、新宿区真实城市环境），实现了更快的收敛、参数不确定性降低一个数量级、重构误差降低高达50%。
AI.motivation: RANS模拟的准确性依赖于闭合模型及其参数，但这些参数通常从基准案例推断，不适用于包含不同物理机制的真实城市环境，即RANS城市建模的"可迁移性"问题。现有方法缺乏鲁棒、高效的顺序参数推断方案。
AI.method: 推导了参数正则化集成卡尔曼滤波（PR-EnKF）作为顺序参数估计数据同化问题的解析解；通过先验知识正则化代价函数确保贝叶斯更新在物理范围内；采用由简到繁的迁移学习策略，首先在孤立建筑上推断参数，再迁移至高层建筑、多建筑阵列及新宿区真实城市环境。
AI.result: PR-EnKF实现了更快的收敛速度；参数不确定性降低一个数量级；重构误差降低高达50%；正则化机制使得PR-EnKF能够选择性更新最重要的参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了鲁棒的大规模城市流动模拟，同时减少了城市规划和空气质量评估中模型优化的计算开销，有效解决了RANS城市建模的参数可迁移性问题。

title: Atomic oven with rapid thermal response for atom experiments
summary: Atomic oven generating controllable atomic beam flux plays a fundmental role in quantum gas experiments. Here, we report a new heater design that can heat up an high temperature atomic oven with fast thermal response. The new heater shows a heating rate improved by 7.65 times comparing to that of the onventional resistive heater while the crucible temperature can heated up to 1200K. With this oven, we generated a collimated ytterbium beam with flux exceeding $10^{14} \text{ atoms/s}$ at 823 K. We believe that our design offers a promising solution for shortening experimental dead time and improve the experiment efficiency in cold atom researches.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种用于冷原子实验的新型原子炉加热器设计，其加热速率比传统电阻加热器提升7.65倍，可将坩埚加热至1200K，并在823K下产生通量超过10^14原子/s的准直镱原子束，有望缩短实验死时间并提高效率。
AI.motivation: 原子炉产生的可控原子束通量在量子气体实验中至关重要，传统电阻加热器热响应慢，导致实验死时间较长，效率低下。
AI.method: 设计了一种新型加热器，相比传统电阻加热器实现了7.65倍的加热速率提升，可将坩埚温度加热至1200K。
AI.result: 在823K温度下，该原子炉产生了通量超过10^14 atoms/s的准直镱原子束；加热速率相比传统电阻加热器提升了7.65倍。
AI.conclusion: 该设计为缩短冷原子实验中的死时间、提高实验效率提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

title: Stability of gas flow past viscoelastic compliant solid
summary: Stability of a high-speed gas flow past a compliant solid is impacted by two distinct features: high solid-to-fluid density ratio ($ρ_r$), and flow compressibility when flow speeds are comparable to acoustic speed. This study investigates the linear stability of a shear-driven compressible gas flow past a compliant substrate modelled as a continuum Neo-Hookean solid. Numerical solutions of the eigenvalue problem reveal that at high density ratios, the dominant instabilities are the elastic shear-waves of the solid. Our study shows that flow compressibility exerts a non-monotonic effect on the growth rate of the elastic modes; the growth rate increases with increase in Mach number up to $\mbox{Ma} \approx 2$ before subsequently decreasing. Furthermore, for compressible flows, strong thermal-coupling renders the base state highly sensitive to both the solid-to-fluid thermal conductivity ratio and the substrate's bottom-surface temperature. Numerical results demonstrate that increasing the conductivity ratio destabilizes the system, whereas increasing the bottom wall temperature is stabilizing. The stability equations, analyzed in the asymptotic limit of $ρ_r \mbox{Re} \gg 1$, reveals that the fluid-solid system de-couples at the leading order with the elastic modes emerging as a solution of the linear elasticity equations under free-shear condition at the interface. We derive a closed-form expression for the leading-order growth rate of the instability, which shows an excellent agreement with the numerical solution. This expression explicitly quantifies the influence of fluid stresses at the interface, which can in-turn be expressed as integrals of the flow solution isolating the distinct physical mechanisms driving the instability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高密度比可压缩气体流经顺应性固体（Neo-Hookean）的线性稳定性。数值分析表明，弹性剪切波是主导失稳模式；马赫数对增长率呈非单调影响（Ma≈2达峰值）；热耦合强度显著受导热比和底部温度调控；高密度比极限下流固解耦，推导出增长率闭合表达式与数值解高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 探究高固体-流体密度比和流动可压缩性这两个特征如何共同影响高速气体流经顺应性固体的稳定性，填补现有研究空白。
AI.method: 采用线性稳定性分析，将顺应性基底建模为连续Neo-Hookean固体，通过数值求解特征值问题，并结合ρ_r Re ≫ 1渐近极限分析推导解析表达式。
AI.result: 高密度比下主导失稳为弹性剪切波；马赫数对增长率呈非单调影响（Ma≈2最大）；导热比增大促进失稳，底壁温度升高起稳定作用；渐近分析推导的增长率闭合公式与数值解高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 明确了可压缩性、热耦合和密度比在流固耦合稳定性中的关键作用，给出了量化界面流体应力影响的解析表达式，揭示了失稳的物理机制。

title: Particle dynamics in nonlinear electromagnetic waves: chaos onset, diffusive heating, and wave surfing
summary: We investigate the dynamics of charged particles interacting with ultra-intense electromagnetic X-modes in strongly magnetized plasmas. We demonstrate that particle motion becomes chaotic for relative wave intensities $δ= B_w/B_0 \gtrsim 0.25$ (not above the field reversal threshold $δ\geq 1$). The transition to chaos occurs via the Chirikov resonance overlap mechanism and the related destruction of Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser (KAM) tori. The maximum Lyapunov exponent increases logarithmically with $δ$, even though the unmagnetized $δ\to \infty$ limit is strictly integrable. In the $δ\gg 1$ regime, incomplete re-laminarization of the phase space flow leads to two distinct populations: (i) the majority of particles undergoing stochastic diffusion, and (ii) a fraction of particles that become phase-locked with the wave, experiencing macroscopic intermittent surfing (Lévy flights). The 1D Particle-In-Cell simulations using the EPOCH code in the highly magnetized ($σ\gg 1$) and under-dense regime are generally consistent with the Hamiltonian single-particle theory. The dissipation fraction of the initial EM energy remains mild.

AI.tldr: 研究了强磁化等离子体中带电粒子与超强电磁X模波的相互作用，发现当相对波强度δ≥0.25时粒子运动进入混沌状态，混沌通过Chirikov共振重叠机制发生，在δ>>1区域出现不完全再层流化，产生随机扩散和间歇性Lévy飞行的两群粒子，EPOCH模拟与哈密顿单粒子理论基本一致。
AI.motivation: 探索强磁化等离子体中带电粒子在超强电磁波作用下的动力学行为，特别是混沌转变机制及其物理后果，理解高能量密度物理中的粒子加速与输运过程。
AI.method: 采用哈密顿单粒子理论分析相空间动力学，结合Chirikov共振重叠准则判断混沌转变阈值，计算最大Lyapunov指数量化混沌程度；使用1D PIC模拟（EPOCH代码）在强磁化(σ>>1)和欠密等离子体区域验证理论结果。
AI.result: 混沌阈值出现在δ≈0.25（远低于场反转阈值δ≥1）；最大Lyapunov指数随δ对数增长；δ>>1时出现不完全再层流化，多数粒子随机扩散，部分粒子与波锁相产生Lévy飞行行为；EM能量耗散分数较小。
AI.conclusion: 强磁化等离子体中超强电磁波驱动的粒子混沌动力学具有非平凡特征：混沌阈值较低且δ→∞极限的可积性与有限δ时的混沌共存；高δ区域的不完全再层流化导致粒子群体的双峰分布；PIC模拟与理论预测一致，但能量耗散率不高。

title: Electron-beam Writing of Spectrally Uniform Green Single-photon Emitters in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
summary: Scalable quantum photonic technologies require single-photon emitters whose positions and emission energies can be engineered simultaneously. Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is an attractive room-temperature host, but deterministic creation of spectrally reproducible emitters remains challenging. Here, we use a standard scanning electron microscope as a direct-writing tool to activate bright green single-photon emitters in hBN at predefined sites, without ion implantation or post-fabrication thermal annealing. The written emitters exhibit reproducible zero-phonon-line emission centered near 536 nm, room-temperature antibunching with g(2)(0) as low as 0.08, high brightness, strong linear polarization, and stable emission. Thickness-dependent activation, stacking experiments, cathodoluminescence spectroscopy, and first-principles calculations support a carbon-related defect complex as the most plausible origin of the emission. As a proof of nanophotonic compatibility, we further activate emitters in a nanoparticle-on-mirror plasmonic nanocavity and observe photoluminescence enhancement accompanied by shortened emission lifetimes. These results establish electron-beam direct writing as a practical route to site-selective, spectrally uniform green quantum emitters in hBN, offering a promising basis for integrated room-temperature quantum photonic architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种利用标准扫描电子显微镜作为直写工具，在六方氮化硼（hBN）中按需激活明亮的绿色单光子发射器的方法。这些发射器具有可重复的零声子线发射（~536 nm）、室温反聚束（g²(0)低至0.08）、高亮度、强线偏振和稳定发射。通过厚度依赖性激活、堆叠实验、阴极发光光谱和第一性原理计算，支持碳相关缺陷复合体为最可能的发射来源。进一步在纳米颗粒-镜面等离子体纳米腔中激活发射器，观察到光致发光增强和发射寿命缩短。该工作建立了电子束直写作为在hBN中实现位置选择性、光谱均匀的绿色量子发射器的实用途径。
AI.motivation: 可扩展量子光子技术需要能够同时工程化位置和发射能量的单光子发射器。hBN是具吸引力的室温宿主材料，但确定性创建光谱可重复的发射器仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 使用标准扫描电子显微镜作为直写工具，在hBN中按需激活发射器，无需离子注入或退火。结合厚度依赖性实验、堆叠实验、阴极发光光谱和第一性原理计算分析发射机制。
AI.result: 实现了位置可控的绿色单光子发射器，零声子线~536 nm，室温g²(0)低至0.08，高亮度，强线偏振，稳定发射。在等离子体纳米腔中实现了光致发光增强和寿命缩短。
AI.conclusion: 电子束直写是在hBN中实现位置选择性、光谱均匀的绿色量子发射器的实用方法，为集成室温量子光子架构提供了有前景的基础。

title: A dual--continuum phase-field model for hydraulic fracturing: Viscosity-dominated regime and fluid lag
summary: The phase-field model regularizes sharp fractures into a diffuse representation, blurring the boundary between the fracture and the intact material. This blurring makes it difficult to capture distinct domain processes in hydraulic fracturing, where Reynolds flow governs the fracture and Darcy flow describes the surrounding porous matrix. Consequently, the blurred delineation artificially smears the pressure field across the fracture--matrix interface, which is acceptable in toughness-dominated hydraulic fracturing regimes where pressure drops within the fracture are negligible. However, in viscosity-dominated regimes, typically for actual subsurface injections due to high injection rates, the fluid pressure drops more drastically, and the fluid front may even lag behind the propagating fracture tip, a phenomenon that a smeared pressure field cannot capture. Despite its relevance, the viscosity-dominated regime has not been addressed by any existing phase-field models to date, likely due to its numerical instability. In this study, we propose a dual--continuum phase-field model based on double-porosity microporomechanics that explicitly separates mesoscale crack pressure from micropore pressure. The framework provides a variationally consistent formulation alongside phase-field--dependent poroelasticity. To ensure the numerical stability of the hydromechanical coupling, a fixed-stress split scheme is modified for two independent fluid pressures, while a variational inequality constraint is applied to reproduce fluid lag. Verified against the closed-form solutions in toughness-dominated, viscosity-dominated, and early-time transitional regimes, the model accurately captures complex fluid flow behavior and transient fluid lag within the fracture, and opens a new frontier for applying phase-field models to realistic viscosity-dominated hydraulic fracturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于双孔隙微观力学的新型双连续相场模型，通过显式分离裂隙压力和孔隙压力，解决了现有相场模型无法捕捉黏度主导水力压裂中显著压力降和流体滞后现象的局限性，并验证了其在黏度主导、韧性主导及过渡区的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有相场模型在黏度主导水力压裂中无法捕捉显著的压力降和流体滞后现象，因为其弥散裂缝表示模糊了裂缝-基质界面，人为平滑了压力场。这一问题迄今未被解决，主要由于数值不稳定性。
AI.method: 提出基于双孔隙微观力学的双连续相场模型，显式分离介观裂缝压力和微观孔隙压力；采用变分一致公式化与相场相关的孔隙弹性；改进固定应力分裂方案处理两个独立流体压力；应用变分不等式约束再现流体滞后。
AI.result: 模型在韧性主导、黏度主导和早期过渡区均与封闭形式解吻合，准确捕捉了裂缝内的复杂流体流动行为和瞬态流体滞后现象。
AI.conclusion: 该模型打开了将相场模型应用于实际黏度主导水力压裂的新前沿，克服了现有方法在数值稳定性和物理准确性方面的关键瓶颈。

title: Hydrogenic rotational levels with spin-0 or spin-1/2 constituent particles
summary: We employ nonrelativistic quantum electrodynamics with a unified description of two-body systems with spin-0 or spin-1/2 constituents, arbitrary masses, and arbitrary magnetic moments in rotational states with $L>1$, to present state-of-the-art theoretical predictions for muonic, kaonic, and antiprotonic atoms that have recently been measured or are targeted by upcoming experiments. We show that the theoretical accuracy can further be improved, opening the possibility of using precision spectroscopy of muonic and hadronic atoms for high-accuracy determinations of nuclear charge radii and nuclear electric dipole polarizabilities, and for testing the existence of hypothetical long-range hadronic interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用非相对论量子电动力学统一描述自旋0或1/2、任意质量、任意磁矩、转动量子数L>1的两体系统，为近期测量或即将实验的μ子、Ka子、反质子原子提供最新理论预测，并展示进一步提高精度的可能性，从而将精密光谱学用于核电荷半径、核电偶极极化率的高精度测定以及检验假想的长程强子相互作用。
AI.motivation: 为μ子、Ka子、反质子原子提供更精确的理论预测，以支持实验测量和基础物理参数的提取。
AI.method: 采用非相对论量子电动力学（NRQED）统一描述自旋0或1/2、任意质量、任意磁矩、L>1转动态的两体系统。
AI.result: 理论精度可以进一步提升，使得精密光谱学可用于核电荷半径、核电偶极极化率的高精度测定及检验假想的长程强子相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 基于NRQED的方法能够提升理论预测精度，拓展μ子和强子原子精密光谱学的应用范围。

title: Contrary to Newtonian trends: Early flow transition and drag enhancement at low to intermediate Reynolds number flows of structured fluids
summary: The flow of structured fluids, such as polymeric and micellar solutions, involves a strong two-way coupling between flow kinematics and internal microstructural dynamics, including polymer stretching, micellar scission, and reformation. These interactions yield complex nonlinear rheological responses, including viscoelasticity, shear-thinning, and thixotropy. In this study, we perform high-fidelity numerical simulations of micellar solution flow past a circular cylinder using the Modified Bautista-Manero (MBM) model, which couples a viscoelastic constitutive equation with a kinetic equation for fluidity to capture reversible micellar breakage and reformation. Model parameters are derived from quantitative fitting of experimental data for the EHAC-NaSal system. Our results reveal substantially richer flow dynamics than in Newtonian fluids under the same conditions. Transitions to unsteady flow occur at significantly lower Reynolds numbers, indicating greater instability driven by microstructural effects. At intermediate Reynolds numbers, micellar flows exhibit quasi-periodic behaviour, contrasting with classical periodic vortex shedding in Newtonian cases. Unlike the monotonic drag reduction in Newtonian fluids, micellar solutions show an anomalous drag increase. Wake characteristics reverse with regime: larger recirculation zones at low Reynolds numbers but more compact wakes in unsteady flows. Lift coefficients and Strouhal numbers are consistently increased. Vorticity fields display pronounced spatial localisation within thin near-wake shear layers. A dynamic mode decomposition analysis reveals coexisting unstable time-decaying and self-sustained modes in micellar flows, whereas only self-sustained modes appear in Newtonian cases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高保真数值模拟研究了胶束溶液在圆柱绕流中的流动动力学，使用修正的Bautista-Manero模型捕捉可逆胶束断裂与重组。结果表明，与牛顿流体相比，胶束溶液在更低雷诺数下出现失稳、准周期行为、反常阻力增加、涡量场局域化以及共存的不稳定衰减与自维持模态等更丰富的动力学特征。
AI.motivation: 揭示结构化流体（如胶束溶液）在流动中微观结构动力学与宏观流场之间的双向耦合机制，理解其复杂的非线性流变响应，尤其是相比牛顿流体表现出的独特不稳定性与动力学行为。
AI.method: 采用修正的Bautista-Manero（MBM）模型进行高保真数值模拟，该模型耦合了粘弹性本构方程与流体动力学方程以描述可逆胶束断裂与重组；模型参数通过对EHAC-NaSal体系实验数据的定量拟合确定；流动构型为圆柱绕流；使用动态模态分解（DMD）分析流动模态。
AI.result: 胶束溶液在更低雷诺数下即发生失稳；中间雷诺数下呈现准周期行为而非经典周期性涡脱落；出现反常阻力增加而非减阻；尾流特征随流态反转（低雷诺数下回流区更大，非稳态下尾流更紧凑）；升力系数和斯特劳哈尔数持续增大；涡量场在近尾剪切层内显著局域化；DMD显示胶束流中存在共存的不稳定衰减模态与自维持模态。
AI.conclusion: 微观结构动力学（胶束断裂与重组）显著改变了流动的稳定性和动力学特征，胶束溶液表现出比牛顿流体更丰富、更复杂的流动行为，不能简单用经典流体力学框架预测。

title: Machine-Learning-Enabled Full-State Reconstruction of Fusion Plasmas from Minimal Sensor Measurements
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures; Submitted to EPS Plasma Physics Conference 2026
summary: Plasma in nuclear fusion reactors is only partially observable: diagnostics are constrained by limited access, cost, and the harsh plasma environment, while high-fidelity simulations remain prohibitively costly at reactor-relevant scales to address the observability gap. This paper presents an ML model for reconstructing full-domain plasma states from a small number of accessible measurements. The model combines temporal encoding of sparse sensor histories with spatial decoding into complete plasma-field maps. Demonstrations using high-fidelity kinetic simulation data show that multiple coupled plasma quantities can be reconstructed from only a few density sensors, with robustness to sparse and randomly located probes. The approach provides a route toward diagnostic augmentation, real-time state estimation, and data-driven digital twins for fusion-relevant plasmas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种机器学习模型，利用少量可访问的测量数据重建核聚变反应堆等离子体的全域状态，结合时间编码和空间解码，在少量密度传感器下实现了多个耦合等离子体量的鲁棒重建，为聚变等离子体的诊断增强、实时状态估计和数据驱动的数字孪生提供了途径。
AI.motivation: 核聚变反应堆中的等离子体只能被部分观测，诊断受到有限访问、成本和恶劣等离子体环境的制约，而高保真模拟在反应堆相关尺度下成本过高，无法解决可观测性差距。
AI.method: 构建ML模型，将稀疏传感器历史的时间编码与完整等离子体场图的空间解码相结合，从少量可访问的测量数据中重建全域等离子体状态。
AI.result: 使用高保真动力学仿真数据验证，表明仅凭少量密度传感器即可重建多个耦合等离子体量，且对稀疏和随机分布的探针具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为聚变相关等离子体的诊断增强、实时状态估计和数据驱动的数字孪生提供了可行路径。

title: Fluctuation -- dissipation physics of stimulated light scattering from laser-driven density gratings
summary: The fluctuation -- dissipation theorem (FDT) is shown to provide a powerful resource for the analysis of stimulated light scattering from laser-driven density gratings, including stimulated Brillouin scattering and its kinetic-regime extension. In the physical setting of stimulated light scattering by density gratings, the FDT establishes that the dynamics of disturbances induced in a medium by a laser-driven electrostrictive force unfolds via the same physical pathways as the dynamics of internal, spontaneous fluctuations in this medium at equilibrium. When integrated into a suitable kinetic framework, the FDT leads to a significant simplification of the analysis of stimulated light scattering, allowing the stimulated gain/loss spectrum to be found directly from the spectrum of spontaneous density fluctuations without the need to solve kinetic equations with an external-field term. Operating within this framework, we derive a physically intuitive closed-form solution for the stimulated gain that accurately recovers all the signature properties of sound-wave-mediated Stokes amplification in the hydrodynamic regime, provides a continuous, fully analytical crossover from the hydrodynamic to kinetic regime of stimulated scattering, and explains distinctly different properties of kinetic stimulated scattering from density gratings, consistent with experiments on stimulated scattering in moderate-pressure gases. As important physical benchmark, in the limits of vanishingly low and very high collision frequencies, this solution for the SBS gain recovers the FDT-transformed solutions of, respectively, the Vlasov and Navier -- Stokes equations.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了涨落-耗散定理（FDT）可作为分析激光驱动密度光栅受激光散射（包括受激布里渊散射及其动力学区域扩展）的强大工具，通过FDT可直接从自发密度涨落谱得到受激增益/损耗谱，无需求解含外场项的动力学方程，并给出了从流体动力学到动力学区域的连续解析解。
AI.motivation: 简化受激光散射分析，避免求解含外场项的复杂动力学方程，并建立从流体动力学区域到动力学区域的连续解析框架，以解释实验观察到的不同散射特性。
AI.method: 将涨落-耗散定理（FDT）集成到动力学框架中，利用FDT将受激散射增益/损耗谱与自发密度涨落谱直接关联，从而避免求解含外源项的动力学方程。
AI.result: 推导出物理直观的受激增益闭式解，该解在流体动力学区域准确恢复声波介导的斯托克斯放大特征，提供从流体动力学到动力学区域的完全解析交叉，解释动力学受激散射的不同特性，并在低碰撞频率和高碰撞频率极限下分别恢复Vlasov方程和Navier-Stokes方程的FDT变换解。
AI.conclusion: 涨落-耗散定理为受激光散射分析提供了强大的简化工具，能够在不求解含外场项动力学方程的情况下获得完整的增益谱，并实现从流体动力学到动力学区域的连续解析描述。

title: Super-molasses returns: All optical near-resonance laser cooling and trapping of neutral atoms from background vapor
summary: Laser cooled and trapped atoms have been the workhorse of atomic physics for the past four decades. The predominant method has been the highly versatile Magneto-Optical Trap. We describe an alternative laser trap involving a simple geometry of collimated laser beams that provides both a velocity and position dependent restoring force such that a dense cloud of cold atoms is formed. This technique produces similar atom number ($>10^6$) and density ($10^{10}$\,atoms/cm$^{3}$) to the Magneto-Optical Trap, albeit with \emph{no magnetic field}. The beam geometry is compatible with conventional sub-Doppler cooling techniques, allowing the trapped cloud to be cooled to $< 10~μ$K. We demonstrate the validity and robustness of the trap by capturing $^{87}$Rb atoms directly from the background vapor and provide a theoretical discussion of the underlying principles. This trap has many unique properties that make it highly suitable for quantum sensing, timing, and computing applications as well as a new tool in fundamental science and metrology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需磁场的激光阱，仅用准直激光束的简单几何结构实现对冷原子的速度依赖和位置依赖的恢复力，可捕获超过10^6个原子，密度达10^10 atoms/cm³，并可与亚多普勒冷却技术结合使温度低于10 μK。
AI.motivation: 传统的磁光阱（MOT）虽然高度通用但需要磁场，本文旨在开发一种无需磁场的替代激光阱方案，简化实验装置并拓展应用场景。
AI.method: 采用准直激光束构成的简单几何结构，通过速度依赖和位置依赖的恢复力形成冷原子云；从背景蒸气中直接捕获⁸⁷Rb原子；结合亚多普勒冷却技术进一步降温。
AI.result: 实现了原子数>10^6、密度10^10 atoms/cm³的冷原子云，温度低于10 μK，性能与MOT相当但无需磁场。
AI.conclusion: 该激光阱具有独特性质，非常适合量子传感、守时、量子计算以及基础科学和计量学应用。

title: Mean-flow-based reduced-order models of turbulent channel flow
summary: Reduced-order models (ROMs) for turbulent flows based on Galerkin projection can achieve reasonable accuracy using equation-based modal bases derived from the linearized Navier-Stokes equations through the controllability and observability Gramians. The use of the modal bases obtained from linearized equations around a mean state has been seen to enhance the first- and second-order statistics in the ROM, but the use of the mean state was not necessarily extended to the equations of motion, as it implies the treatment of the divergence of the Reynolds stresses in the Galerkin projection. In this work, we present a mean-flow-based framework for ROMs in which the projection of the Reynolds stresses is solved through a modified modal basis and the knowledge of the mean flow. This framework achieves turbulence statistics comparable to those of a reference direct numerical simulation (DNS) in a minimal channel at $Re_τ \approx 185$. Short-time forecasting with this framework is assessed, where balanced truncation modal bases outperform controllability modes in ROMs, yielding a reconstruction of the velocity field comparable to the Galerkin projection of proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) modes. This framework can extend analysis based on linearisations around the mean turbulent flow, which became widespread in recent years, to include explicitly non-linear interactions between modes, enabling accurate models at higher Reynolds number.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于平均流的湍流降阶模型框架，通过修正模态基和平均流知识求解雷诺应力投影，在Re_τ≈185的微通道中实现了与直接数值模拟相当的湍流统计量，并展示了短时预报能力，其中平衡截断模态优于可控性模态。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Galerkin投影的湍流降阶模型虽能利用线性化Navier-Stokes方程的模态基提升统计精度，但平均流并未被扩展到运动方程中，导致雷诺应力散度项在Galerkin投影中难以处理。
AI.method: 提出平均流框架，通过修正模态基和平均流知识显式求解雷诺应力的投影；采用平衡截断（BT）和可控性格拉姆ian模态（CM）构建ROM，并与POD-Galerkin方法对比。
AI.result: 在Re_τ≈185的最小通道中，所提框架实现了与DNS相当的湍流统计量；短时预报中，BT模态优于CM模态，重构速度场精度与POD-Galerkin相当。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将基于平均流线性化的分析扩展至显式非线性模态相互作用，为更高雷诺数的精确湍流建模提供了可行路径。

title: Turbulent Magnetogenesis and Large-scale Magnetic Dynamo Amplification in Ion--electron Plasmas
summary: Using fully kinetic simulations that capture unprecedentedly large (from electron to ion) scales, we study magnetogenesis driven by continuous large-scale forcing until nonlinear dynamo saturation. We uncover a two-stage mechanism in collisionless ion-electron plasmas whose dynamics diverge dramatically from the pair-plasma case. In the first phase, electron pressure anisotropy triggers electron-Weibel modes, seeding small-scale magnetic fields. Then, a second growth phase emerges when the more massive ions develop their own strong anisotropy and drive ion-Weibel-type modes; concurrently, a Biermann-battery mechanism contributes to amplifying the magnetic field. This combined dynamics provides a tenfold amplification of the magnetic field in comparison to the pair-plasma case. Over long times, dynamo action continues until the system reaches a statistical steady state. This self-consistent kinetic mechanism provides a plausible explanation for robust magnetogenesis wherever an external forcing continuously stirs the plasma.

AI.tldr: 通过覆盖从电子到离子尺度的全动力学模拟，研究了连续大尺度强迫驱动下碰撞less离子-电子等离子体中的磁发生产生机制，揭示了与对等离子体情况截然不同的两阶段动力学过程，最终实现磁场十倍增强。
AI.motivation: 探究碰撞less离子-电子等离子体中由连续大尺度强迫驱动的磁发生产生机制，特别是与对等离子体情况的差异，以及最终达到非线性发电机饱和的完整物理过程。
AI.method: 采用全动力学模拟，覆盖从电子到离子的超大尺度范围，模拟连续大尺度强迫驱动下的磁发电机过程直至非线性饱和。
AI.result: 发现了碰撞less离子-电子等离子体中的两阶段磁发生机制：第一阶段由电子压力各向异性触发电子-Weibel模，产生小尺度种子磁场；第二阶段由离子各向异性驱动离子-Weibel模，同时Biermann电池机制贡献磁场放大，最终磁场强度是对等离子体情况的十倍。长时间后系统达到统计稳态。
AI.conclusion: 这种自洽的动力学机制为外部强迫持续搅拌等离子体环境中鲁棒的磁发生产生提供了合理解释。

title: Second-harmonic generation from an optically levitated KTP nanocrystal in vacuum
summary: The optically levitated system in vacuum has emerged as a powerful platform for studies of fundamental physics and precision measurements. Although various nanoparticles have been successfully levitated in vacuum, they typically lack the capability to support optical nonlinear processes. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the stable levitation of a potassium titanyl phosphate (KTP) nonlinear nanocrystal in vacuum and investigate its second-harmonic generation (SHG) properties. This levitated system intrinsically provides a pristine dark-background environment with a high signal-to-noise ratio. The trapping laser simultaneously serves as a fundamental light for efficient SHG. Moreover, the polarization of the collected SHG signal is correlated with that of the fundamental laser, providing clear evidence of the optical torque enabling controllable alignment of the nanocrystal with the driving field. Our work establishes a new route toward exploring nonlinear optical processes in vacuum levitation systems and designing novel nanodevices with high manipulation agility in a fully contact-free environment.

AI.tldr: 本文实验证明了在真空中稳定悬浮KTP非线性纳米晶体，并研究了其二次谐波产生性质，为真空悬浮系统中的非线性光学过程开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 现有的真空光学悬浮系统虽然能悬浮多种纳米颗粒，但通常缺乏支持光学非线性过程的能力，因此需要探索可在真空中实现非线性光学效应的悬浮体系。
AI.method: 在真空中稳定悬浮KTP非线性纳米晶体，利用捕获激光同时作为基频光驱动二次谐波产生，收集并分析SHG信号与基频光的偏振关联性。
AI.result: 成功实现了KTP纳米晶体在真空中的稳定悬浮，获得了高信噪比的二次谐波信号，并观察到SHG信号偏振与基频激光偏振相关，证实了光扭矩可实现纳米晶体与驱动场的可控对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在真空悬浮系统中探索非线性光学过程以及设计具有高操控灵活性的全无接触新型纳米器件提供了新途径。

title: SoPlasmaFoam: an OpenFOAM-based solver for streamer and dielectric barrier discharges with adaptive mesh refinement
summary: SoPlasmaFoam is an open-source, multi-region plasma-dielectric solver built on OpenFOAM, integrated with the PETSc linear-algebra suite (CPU and GPU back-ends), the blastAMR adaptive-mesh-refinement library (hexahedral and polyhedral meshes), and the ROUND family of high-resolution convective schemes. It solves drift-diffusion-reaction transport for charged species, coupled self-consistently to Poisson's equation explicitly or semi-implicitly, with plasma and dielectric regions joined by a monolithic multi-domain coupling for arbitrary curved interfaces. This work makes three contributions. First, a systematic assessment of convective schemes on a stiff scalar-advection problem and the positive-streamer benchmark shows that Scharfetter-Gummel is stable but excessively diffusive on coarse meshes, while ROUNDF outperforms all tested TVD limiters and is recommended for streamer transport. Second, an analysis of Poisson-transport coupling shows that fixed-point correction loops critically control accuracy, that a semi-implicit Poisson formulation does not remove this requirement, and that coupling must be tightened even when Courant and dielectric-relaxation numbers are well below unity. Third, a drift-robust wall boundary condition acting on discretized matrix coefficients is introduced, remaining accurate in the drift-dominated limit where conventional mixed-boundary mappings fail. The solver is validated against a low-pressure DC glow discharge and the positive-streamer benchmark, and its multi-region capability is demonstrated on a nanosecond surface dielectric barrier discharge. Performance analysis confirms memory-bound finite-volume scaling and shows that with AMR the solver is competitive with the fastest reported plasma codes. The framework provides a modular foundation for multiphysics simulations in plasma-assisted combustion, plasma processing, and plasma-based flow control.

AI.tldr: SoPlasmaFoam是一个基于OpenFOAM的开源多区域等离子体-介电求解器，集成了PETSc线性代数套件、blastAMR自适应网格细化库和ROUND高分辨率对流格式。它解决了漂移-扩散-反应输运与泊松方程的自洽耦合，并通过单域多区域耦合连接等离子体和介电区域。本文系统评估了对流格式、泊松-输运耦合以及一种漂移鲁棒的壁面边界条件，在多个基准测试中验证了求解器的性能，并证明了其在自适应网格细化下与最快等离子体代码的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 开发一个开源、模块化、多区域的等离子体-介电求解器，系统评估关键数值方法（对流格式、耦合策略、边界条件）的精度和稳定性，为等离子体辅助燃烧、等离子体处理和等离子体流动控制等多物理场模拟提供坚实基础。
AI.method: 基于OpenFOAM框架构建，集成PETSc（CPU/GPU后端）、blastAMR（六面体/多面体网格自适应细化）、ROUND高分辨率对流格式。采用漂移-扩散-反应模型求解带电粒子输运，与泊松方程显式或半隐式自洽耦合，通过单域多区域耦合处理任意弯曲界面的等离子体-介电区域连接。系统评估了对流格式（Scharfetter-Gummel、TVD限制器、ROUNDF）、泊松-输运耦合的固定点修正循环精度，并引入了一种漂移鲁棒的壁面边界条件。
AI.result: Scharfetter-Gummel在粗网格上过度扩散；ROUNDF优于所有测试的TVD限制器，推荐用于流注输运。固定点修正循环对精度至关重要，半隐式泊松公式不能消除此需求，即使Courant数和介电弛豫数远低于1时也需收紧耦合。漂移鲁棒边界条件在漂移主导极限下保持精确，而传统混合边界映射失效。求解器在低压直流辉光放电和正流注基准中验证，多区域能力在纳秒表面介电阻挡放电中得到展示。性能分析确认了内存受限的有限体积缩放，使用AMR后与最快等离子体代码竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: SoPlasmaFoam是一个模块化、高性能的开源等离子体-介电多区域求解器，推荐ROUNDF格式用于流注模拟，强调了耦合精度控制的重要性，并提供了漂移鲁棒的边界条件。该框架为等离子体辅助燃烧、等离子体处理和等离子体流动控制等多物理场模拟提供了坚实基础。

title: Investigating Role of Electron Correlation Effects via Triple Excitations for Precise Evaluation of Energies and Hyperfine Structure Constants in $^{23}$Na
summary: Accurate determination of hyperfine structure constants in atomic systems provides important insight into the interplay of electron correlation and relativistic effects in the nuclear region. Although sodium (Na) is a relatively light atom, previous all-order relativistic many-body calculations of the magnetic dipole hyperfine constants for the low-lying states of $^{23}$Na show noticeable discrepancies with experiment. To address this, we calculate the ionization potentials and hyperfine structure constants of $^{23}$Na using relativistic coupled-cluster theory with explicit inclusion of triple excitations. We further incorporate corrections from the Breit interaction, quantum electrodynamics, and the Bohr-Weisskopf (BW) effect. Results from lower-order methods are also presented to assess the importance of different physical contributions across states. Our calculations demonstrate that contributions from the lower-order relativistic and BW effects play almost similar roles with the electron correlation effects, including triple excitations, and are essential for reconciling theoretical predictions with experimental observations. This study can also serve as a useful guide for understanding the role of triples in heavier alkali systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用相对论耦合簇理论（包含三重激发）结合Breit相互作用、QED和Bohr-Weisskopf效应修正，精确计算了$^{23}$Na的离解能和超精细结构常数，发现低阶相对论和BW效应与电子关联效应（含三重激发）同等重要，是理论与实验吻合的关键。
AI.motivation: 先前$^{23}$Na低能态磁偶极超精细常数的全阶相对论多体计算结果与实验存在明显偏差，需要更精确的理论方法来解决这一 discrepancy 并深入理解电子关联与相对论效应在核区域的相互作用。
AI.method: 采用包含三重激发的相对论耦合簇理论，并进一步引入Breit相互作用、量子电动力学（QED）修正以及Bohr-Weisskopf（BW）效应修正；同时给出低阶方法的结果用于对比不同物理贡献的重要性。
AI.result: 低阶相对论效应和BW效应的贡献与电子关联效应（包括三重激发）几乎同等重要；包含这些修正后，理论预测与实验观测达成一致。
AI.conclusion: 三重激发在重碱金属体系超精细结构计算中至关重要，该研究为理解triples在更重碱金属系统中的作用提供了有用指导。

title: Experimental and numerical study of the dynamics of sedimenting pairs of semi-flexible fibers close to attractive `aligned' relative configuration
summary: Dynamics of two short semi-flexible fibers settling under gravity in a viscous fluid are investigated at Reynolds numbers Re << 1. We focus on fibers initially relatively close to each other, and we check if later they approach an aligned horizontal configuration, previously identified numerically (Bukowicki and Ekiel-Jezewska, Soft Matter 46 (2019) 9379) as attractive for symmetric initial conditions of moderately elastic filaments. In our experiments, two semi-flexible ball chains sediment in a highly viscous silicone oil. They are initially straight and close to a parallel horizontal relative configuration. Their motion and shape deformation are recorded using two synchronized cameras. For most of the trials, ball chains stay together, with damped oscillations around the symmetric aligned configuration. For a few initial conditions, the ball chains move away horizontally or vertically. To study the behavior over a longer time, we perform numerical simulations, modeling moderately elastic filaments as chains of identical beads, with the centers of consecutive beads connected by springs and with the fibers' elastic resistance to bending. Different initial positions and orientations are considered. Their dynamics are determined by the multipole expansion of the Stokes equations, implemented in the precise Hydromultipole numerical code.
