title: Monolithic Barium Titanate Nanophotonics and Electro-optics
summary: Barium titanate-on-insulator (BTOI) is a compelling material for high-speed integrated photonic modulators due to its large Pockels coefficient (r42 > 1200 pm/V in bulk), which allows for the miniaturization of modulators while maintaining strong electro-optic performance. Sub-wavelength nanostructures monolithically etched into BTOI are particularly exciting, as they offer a path toward subwavelength light-matter interaction and reduced modulator energy consumption. Here, we design, fabricate, and characterize monolithic one-dimensional nanophotonic crystals (PhCs) and high-Q (230k) photonic-crystal Fabry-Perot (FP) cavities in BTOI. We develop and optimize a nanofabrication process that yields anisotropic (75-degree sidewalls) and deep etching that features low optical loss, with racetrack resonators achieving intrinsic quality factors near 1 million and propagation losses of about 0.5 dB/cm. Our photonic crystals exhibit bandgap contrasts greater than 40 dB, and FP cavities reach loaded quality factors up to 230k. We verify ferroelectric domain alignment via second-harmonic generation microscopy and extract an effective Pockels coefficient of 154 pm/V. By probing the microwave response at the PhC band edge, where modulation bandwidth is set by the material's electro-optic response rather than cavity photon lifetime, we measure a 3-dB electro-optic bandwidth of 11 GHz and a 6-dB bandwidth of 21 GHz, consistent with the frequency-dependent roll-off of BTO's r42 coefficient near 10 GHz. Finally, we show a variety of modulation effects in resonators and at photonic crystal band edges, including sideband-resolved modulation, resonant bandwidth-limited modulation, and photonic-crystal based single sideband modulation and frequency comb generation.

AI.tldr: 本文在钛酸钡绝缘体上（BTOI）设计、制备并表征了单片一维纳米光子晶体（PhC）和高Q值（230k）光子晶体法布里-珀罗（FP）腔，实现了低损耗各向异性刻蚀工艺（侧壁75°、传播损耗~0.5 dB/cm、本征Q值近100万），测量得到有效Pockels系数154 pm/V，3-dB电光带宽11 GHz和6-dB带宽21 GHz，并展示了多种调制效应（边带分辨调制、谐振带宽限制调制、单边带调制和频率梳生成）。
AI.motivation: BTOI因其较大的Pockels系数（体材料r42 > 1200 pm/V）而成为高速集成光子调制器的有前景材料，亚波长纳米结构可实现小型化调制器和降低能耗，但需要开发低损耗的纳米加工工艺并验证其电光调制性能。
AI.method: 开发并优化了BTOI的各向异性深刻蚀纳米制造工艺（75°侧壁），制备了微环谐振器、一维光子晶体和FP腔；通过二次谐波显微镜验证铁电畴取向；利用微波探针测量PhC带边和微腔的电光调制响应。
AI.result: 微环谐振器本征Q值近100万、传播损耗~0.5 dB/cm；光子晶体带隙对比度>40 dB；FP腔加载Q值高达230k；有效Pockels系数154 pm/V；3-dB电光带宽11 GHz、6-dB带宽21 GHz；展示了边带分辨调制、谐振带宽限制调制、单边带调制和频率梳生成。
AI.conclusion: BTOI光子晶体结构实现了低损耗纳米加工和高速电光调制，验证了其在集成光子调制器、频率梳生成等应用中的潜力，调制带宽受限于BTO材料本身的r42系数在~10 GHz附近的频率滚降而非腔光子寿命。

title: Spatially variant arbitrary polarization shaping for optical skyrmions generation
summary: Polarization is fundamental degree of freedom of light, crucial for applications from imaging to quantum optics. Although numerous methods can spatially manipulate the polarization orientation, e.g., for generating vector beam, achieving simultaneous, spatially resolved control of both the orientation (ψ) and ellipticity (\c{hi}) remains challenging. Here, we present an efficient and compact platform to generate spatially variant arbitrary polarization states, e.g., optical skyrmions, in free space, using cascaded spatially variant waveplates in a single silica glass plate via ultrafast laser direct writing. We propose two configurations: (1) a spatially variant half-waveplate (S-HWP) and followed by a quarter-waveplate (S-HWP); and (2) two cascaded spatially variant quarter-waveplates (S-QWPs). Design rules linking the target polarization parameters (orientation ψ and ellipticity \c{hi}) to the fast-axis distributions enable spatially resolved arbitrary polarization control. Using these devices, we realize Néel-, Bloch-, and anti-skyrmions of different orders (e.g., second and fourth) and n-π textures (2π and 3π), with polarization-resolved measurements in excellent agreement with simulations. We further demonstrate 3 by 3 arrays comprising either identical or hybrid skyrmions. This approach enables the realization of spatially variant arbitrary polarization state and scalable skyrmion lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通过超快激光直写技术在单片二氧化硅玻璃板内级联空间变波片，实现自由空间任意偏振态（包括光学斯格明子）高效紧凑生成的方法，并实验验证了多种拓扑纹理及可扩展阵列。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽能空间操控偏振取向，但难以同时实现取向(ψ)和椭圆度(χ)的空间分辨调控，亟需一种能产生任意空间变化偏振态的紧凑高效平台。
AI.method: 利用超快激光直写技术在单片二氧化硅玻璃中制备级联空间变波片：配置一为空间变半波片(S-HWP)加空间变四分之一波片(S-QWP)；配置二为两个级联空间变四分之一波片(S-QWPs)。建立了目标偏振参数(ψ, χ)与波片快轴分布之间的设计规则。
AI.result: 实现了Néel型、Bloch型和反斯格明子等多种阶次（二阶、四阶）及n-π纹理（2π、3π）的生成，偏振分辨测量与仿真高度吻合，并演示了3×3同质或混合斯格明子阵列。
AI.conclusion: 该平台可高效实现任意空间变化偏振态及可扩展斯格明子晶格，为矢量光束生成和拓扑光子学提供新途径。

title: Photonic Extreme Learning Machines using Event-Based detection
summary: Photonic extreme learning machines use random optical propagation, detection nonlinearity, and a trained linear readout for energy-efficient and scalable optical computing. However, conventional intensity readout with CCD or CMOS cameras constrain the dimensionality of the hidden representation space. Here, we experimentally replace intensity detection with event-based camera, whose thresholded log-intensity response provides alternative pixel-wise hidden representations: first-event time, binary activation, and event count. In nonlinear two spiral classification task we obtain accuracies of $93\pm 3\%$ with strong intrinsic generalization, and comparable ridge and pseudo-inverse performance indicating sample-limited effective dimensionality. Regression results reveal sensitivity to systematic optical-intensity drift, identifying stability requirements for future event-based PELMs. These results establish event-based detection as a route toward richer photonic hidden representations while clarifying current limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文实验性地将事件相机替代传统强度检测，用于光子极端学习机，通过阈值化对数强度响应提供三种像素级隐藏表征（首次事件时间、二值激活、事件计数），在非线性螺旋分类任务中取得93±3%的准确率，同时揭示了系统光强漂移对回归性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统CCD或CMOS相机的强度读出方式限制了光子极端学习机隐藏表示空间的维度，亟需探索替代检测方案以提升表征能力。
AI.method: 用事件相机替代强度检测，利用其阈值化对数强度响应获取三种新型像素级隐藏表征（首次事件时间、二值激活、事件计数），在非线性螺旋分类任务和回归任务中进行实验验证。
AI.result: 非线性螺旋分类准确率达93±3%，具有良好的泛化能力；脊回归和伪逆性能相当，表明有效维度受样本限制；回归实验对系统光强漂移敏感。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机检测为丰富光子隐藏表征提供了新途径，但需解决光强漂移的稳定性问题，这为未来事件型PELM的发展明确了当前局限性。

title: Thermal vacuum friction of objects with different dimensionality
summary: Radiative forces acting on neutral bodies moving through a thermal bath represent a unique manifestation of the interplay between relativistic kinematics and thermal fluctuations. Vacuum friction is commonly formulated using the fluctuation--dissipation theorem or related statistical approaches, but such treatments can obscure the elementary momentum-transfer processes, especially in relativistic regimes. Here, we develop a purely kinematic momentum-transfer framework in which the radiative force and pressure are obtained by summing individual scattering and absorption events. This approach offers a transparent physical picture while ensuring a self-consistent treatment of Doppler shifts and relativistic transformations. We apply the method to three representative geometries: an isotropic dipolar particle, a thin resonant plate moving normal to its surface, and a thin resonant plate moving parallel to its surface. In the nonrelativistic limit, we derive explicit radiative drag coefficients, providing compact expressions for predicting vacuum friction in moving structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种纯运动学的动量传递框架，通过求和单个散射和吸收事件来计算辐射力和压力，避免了传统涨落-耗散定理方法在相对论情形下的模糊性，并应用于各向同性偶极粒子、垂直运动和平行运动的薄共振板三种几何结构，在非相对论极限下导出了显式的辐射拖曳系数。
AI.motivation: 传统的真空摩擦公式化方法（如涨落-耗散定理）在处理相对论性运动时，会掩盖基本的动量传递过程，使物理图像变得不清晰。作者希望发展一种更透明、物理直观的分析框架。
AI.method: 采用纯运动学动量传递框架，通过求和单个散射和吸收事件来获得辐射力和压力，自洽地处理多普勒频移和相对论变换，并应用于三种代表性几何结构进行分析。
AI.result: 在非相对论极限下，推导出了显式的辐射拖曳系数，为预测运动结构中的真空摩擦提供了紧凑的表达式。
AI.conclusion: 该运动学动量传递框架提供了一种透明、自洽的处理方式，能够清晰地揭示相对论运动中性体与热浴之间辐射力的物理本质，并给出可用的解析结果。

title: An orthogonal-to-non-orthogonal multiplexing format converter
summary: Time-frequency orthogonality has been a foundational principle in the historical development of optical communications, whether in dense wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) within long-reach high-capacity coherent optical transmission or in time-frequency division multiple access within short-reach dense passive optical networks. Towards next-generation agile optical networks, jointly programmable orthogonal and non-orthogonal regulation offers flexible spectral allocation, ultra-dense packet distribution, and increased capacity. For bridging the fundamental differences of physical implementation, we propose and demonstrate a versatile orthogonal to non-orthogonal multiplexing format converter, with application to high-speed coherent optical transmission network enabled by a Talbot-based processor. The programmable Talbot-processed pumps coherently transfer and superpose optical signals of distinct wavelength channels onto a single channel through cross-phase modulation. We first demonstrate flexible conversion of two 80-Gbps WDM QPSK channels separated by 200-250 GHz into a non-orthogonal power-division multiplexing channel, while maintaining the high-quality encoded information in the digital domain. We then validate a digital-subcarrier-multiplexing dense access scenario in which eight 20-Gbps sub-channels are combined, converted, transmitted, and successfully decoded over a field-deployed fiber. The multiplexing format converter promises potential for applications in next-generation optical systems and networks with complex topologies and dense populations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种基于Talbot处理器的正交到非正交复用格式转换器，实现了高速相干光传输网络中灵活的光谱分配和容量提升，在两种实验场景（WDM QPSK通道转换和数字子载波密集接入）中展示了其可行性。
AI.motivation: 下一代敏捷光网络需要灵活的光谱分配、超密集分组分布和容量提升，而传统正交时分/频分复用方式在灵活性和非正交调控方面存在局限，亟需一种能够桥接正交与非正交复用格式物理实现差异的通用转换方案。
AI.method: 提出基于Talbot处理器的复用格式转换器，利用可编程Talbot效应泵浦通过交叉相位调制（XPM）将不同波长通道的光信号相干地转移并叠加到单一通道上，实现从正交（WDM）到非正交（功率域复用）的格式转换。
AI.result: 成功演示了两种场景：(1) 将两个间隔200-250 GHz的80-Gbps WDM QPSK通道灵活转换为非正交功率域复用通道；(2) 将八个20-Gbps数字子载波复用子通道合并、转换、传输并在现场部署光纤上成功解码。
AI.conclusion: 该复用格式转换器在复杂拓扑和密集节点的下一代光系统与网络中具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Where Does Surface $χ^{(2)}$ Come From? A Systematic Derivation of Nonlinear Surface Susceptibilities from Bulk Nonlocal Response
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Companion paper to arXiv:2605.15716
summary: We extend the distributional framework developed in the companion paper [Zolla, arXiv:2605.15716] to the nonlinear case, focusing on the second-order ($χ^{(2)}$) response responsible for second-harmonic generation (SHG). Starting from the most general tensorial nonlocal second-order constitutive relation and combining a spatial moment expansion with a distributional thin-layer limit, we show that the full complexity of the nonlinear interfacial response condenses, at leading order, into two scalars, the nonlinear surface susceptibilities $χ^{(2),s}_\parallel$ and $χ^{(2),s}_\perp$, associated with the tangential and normal components of the electric field, respectively. A key structural result is established: via a marginal integration over one field argument, the nonlinear surface problem reduces recursively to an effective linear one, whose surface susceptibility is determined by the bulk nonlinear kernel alone. Generalized nonlinear Maxwell boundary conditions are derived explicitly for planar and spherical interfaces, and curvature corrections are obtained systematically. The formalism is illustrated on Gaussian, Yukawa, and tensorial Lorentz kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文将分布性框架扩展至非线性情况，聚焦二阶非线性（χ^(2)）响应与二次谐波产生（SHG）。通过空间矩展开与分布性薄层极限，证明非线性界面响应在主导阶可简化为两个标量——切向和法向非线性表面磁化率。关键结论是：通过边缘积分，非线性表面问题可递归约化为有效线性问题。推导了平面和球形界面的广义非线性麦克斯韦边界条件，并系统获得了曲率修正。
AI.motivation: 将已有的线性分布性框架推广至非线性情形，特别是二阶非线性光学响应（如二次谐波产生），以统一描述非线性界面效应的复杂张量结构。
AI.method: 采用空间矩展开结合分布性薄层极限的方法，从最一般的张量非局部二阶本构关系出发，通过边缘积分将非线性表面问题递归约化为有效线性问题，并推导平面和球形界面的边界条件及曲率修正。
AI.result: 非线性界面响应在主导阶简化为两个标量（χ^(2),s_∥ 和 χ^(2),s_⊥）；建立了非线性到线性问题的递归约化结构；推导了广义非线性麦克斯韦边界条件（含曲率修正）；在Gaussian、Yukawa和张量Lorentz核上验证了形式体系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为非线性界面光学提供了统一的分布性理论框架，揭示了非线性表面磁化率的结构简化机制，并建立了与线性问题的递归联系，适用于任意界面几何。

title: Non-Hermitian Dirac Vortex: Minimal Theory for Topological-Cavity Surface-Emitting Laser
summary: We construct a non-Hermitian Dirac-vortex model that combines a complex-mass winding with an infinite-imaginary-potential boundary, extending the Jackiw-Rossi and neutrino-billiard models to the dissipative regime. Moreover, this model serves as a minimal theory for the recently proposed topological-cavity surfaceemitting laser (TCSEL): the imaginary mass encodes vertical radiation loss and the absorbing boundary defines the active region. We derive closed-form expressions for the modal frequencies, thresholds, and tunable vectorbeam polarizations, which are validated experimentally. Our work provides a rare example in which an analytical non-Hermitian topological theory captures the essential physics for engineering practical optoelectronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个非厄米狄拉克涡旋模型，将复数质量缠绕与无限虚数势边界结合，拓展了Jackiw-Rossi和中微子台球模型到耗散体系，并作为拓扑腔面发射激光器（TCSEL）的最小理论模型，推导了模态频率、阈值和可调矢量光束极化的闭式表达式，实验验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 将Jackiw-Rossi和中微子台球模型拓展到耗散（非厄米）体系，并为拓扑腔面发射激光器（TCSEL）提供最小理论模型，用解析非厄米拓扑理论指导实用光电器件工程。
AI.method: 构建了非厄米Dirac-vortex模型，包含复数质量缠绕（虚部编码垂直辐射损耗）和无限虚数势边界（定义有源区），推导了模态频率、阈值和矢量光束偏振的闭式解析表达式。
AI.result: 获得了模态频率、阈值和可调矢量光束偏振的闭式解析表达式，并得到了实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个罕见的范例，证明解析非厄米拓扑理论能够捕捉工程实用光电器件的核心物理。

title: Critically coupled zeroth-order resonance for ultrathin nonlinear photonics
comment: 43 pages, 5 main figures, 16 supplementary figures, 2 supplementary tables. Supplementary Information included
summary: Ultrathin active materials are essential for compact nonlinear and quantum photonic devices, yet no general principle exists to link their optical constants to the cavity designs required for simultaneous field buildup and reflection suppression. Consequently, achieving extreme optical confinement currently relies on trial-and-error optimization for every new material. Here, we establish a design rule for metal-backed cavities that maximizes light-matter interaction by ensuring the simultaneous satisfaction of zeroth-order resonance and critical coupling. We derive a closed-form analytical condition that partitions the (n, k) plane into critically coupled, over-coupled, and under-coupled regimes, each mapping to a specific minimal architecture. The critical curve admits a three-layer open cavity, the over-coupled region a closed cavity with a semi-transparent top mirror, and the under-coupled region a spacer-assisted geometry. For low-loss materials, the closed cavity spatially separates dissipation from field accumulation, allowing the quality factor to be controlled by the external mirror rather than intrinsic medium absorption. We validate this framework with 3R-MoS2, demonstrating a second-harmonic enhancement of 1.19 x 10^5 relative to a monolayer, accompanied by the near-complete suppression of reflected pump waves. These results provide a universal framework for efficient light-matter interaction in ultrathin nonlinear and quantum photonics.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一种金属背腔设计规则，通过同时满足零阶共振和临界耦合条件来最大化光与物质的相互作用，推导出将(n,k)平面划分为临界耦合、过耦合和欠耦合区域的闭式解析条件，并在3R-MoS2材料中验证了该框架，实现了相对于单层的1.19×10^5倍二次谐波增强和反射泵浦波的近乎完全抑制。
AI.motivation: 超薄活性材料对紧凑型非线性和量子光子器件至关重要，但目前缺乏将光学常数与同时实现场增强和反射抑制的腔体设计联系起来的通用原理，导致极端光约束依赖于针对每种新材料的试错优化。
AI.method: 推导出闭式解析条件，将(n,k)平面划分为临界耦合、过耦合和欠耦合三个区域，每个区域对应特定的最小结构：临界耦合对应三层开腔，过耦合对应带半透明顶镜的闭腔，欠耦合对应间隔层辅助结构。通过3R-MoS2实验验证该框架。
AI.result: 在3R-MoS2中实现了相对于单层的1.19×10^5倍二次谐波增强，同时近乎完全抑制了反射泵浦波。对于低损耗材料，闭腔可将耗散与场累积在空间上分离，使品质因子可由外部反射镜而非介质本征吸收控制。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为超薄非线性和量子光子学中的高效光-物质相互作用提供了通用设计原则。

title: All-optical control of coherent perfect absorption via frequency conversion
summary: Coherent perfect absorption (CPA) extinguishes optical fields through interference and dissipation, but conventional implementations rely on material loss that is largely fixed after fabrication. Here we demonstrate all-optically controllable CPA based on frequency conversion in a periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide resonator. Pump-driven frequency conversion couples a resonant signal field at 1581 nm in the main system to a non-resonant environmental mode at 780 nm, creating a dynamically tunable effective loss channel. The nonlinear cavity acts as a tunable lossy beamsplitter without intrinsic material absorption. Under coherent two-sided signal injection, we observe up to 92 % absorption. We further introduce environment-assisted CPA by injecting an external field into the frequency-converted environmental mode, turning the environment from a passive loss reservoir into an addressable coherent control port. Our results establish a frequency-conversion-based platform for all-optical control of dissipation in CPA, combining pump-tunable loss with environment-assisted coherent control.

AI.tldr: 本文通过周期性极化铌酸锂波导谐振腔中的频率转换，实现了全光学可控的相干完美吸收（CPA），泵浦驱动的频率转换将1581 nm信号耦合到780 nm非谐振环境模，创造了动态可调的有效损耗通道，在双向信号注入下实现高达92%的吸收，并引入了环境辅助CPA机制。
AI.motivation: 传统CPA依赖于材料固有损耗，而材料损耗在器件制备后基本固定，缺乏动态可调性。本文旨在通过非线性频率转换实现全光学可控的CPA，克服传统方案的局限性。
AI.method: 利用周期性极化铌酸锂波导谐振腔中的泵浦驱动频率转换，将主系统中1581 nm的谐振信号耦合到780 nm的非谐振环境模，创建动态可调的有效损耗通道；非线性腔体充当无需本征材料吸收的可调有损分束器；通过向频率转换后的环境模注入外部场，引入环境辅助CPA机制。
AI.result: 在相干双向信号注入下实现了高达92%的吸收；成功展示了环境辅助CPA，将环境从被动损耗库转变为可寻址的相干控制端口。
AI.conclusion: 建立了基于频率转换的全光学CPA平台，兼具泵浦可调损耗与环境辅助相干控制能力，为动态调控耗散提供了新途径。

title: Characterization of Event-Based Vision Sensors for High-Speed Optical Instrumentation
summary: Event-based vision sensors provide asynchronous event generation and microsecond timestamp resolution, which may be useful for high-speed optical measurements. However, precise event timestamps do not necessarily guarantee accurate reconstruction of temporally varying optical signals, particularly under dense and spatially extended illumination, imposing operational limits when used as optical interrogators that remain underexplored in the literature. To address this knowledge gap, this work presents a systematic, quantitative characterization of the temporal response and waveform reconstruction fidelity of an IMX636-based event camera under both controlled sinusoidal and pulsed optical excitation. For this, frequency-domain measurements are first used to evaluate modulation response, event-rate behavior, polarity balance, and spectral reconstruction fidelity over a wide range of illumination conditions and region-of-interest geometries. Then, complementary pulse-based measurements quantify first-event latency, response duration, recovery dynamics, and pulse-width reconstruction accuracy under rapidly repeated excitation, showing that optical transitions can be detected with first-event latencies below 5 microseconds. However, the complete event response extends over significantly longer timescales due to photoreceptor dynamics, refractory behavior, and readout serialization. Under high-frequency modulation and short-pulse excitation, the reconstructed waveforms progressively degrade because of temporal spreading and imbalance between positive and negative event generation. The measurements further demonstrate that the temporal fidelity of the reconstructed signal depends strongly on the geometry and spatial activity of the selected region of interest.

AI.tldr: 本文系统表征了基于IMX636事件相机在正弦和脉冲光学激励下的时间响应与波形重建保真度，发现事件相机虽能实现亚微秒级延迟，但由于光感受器动力学、不应期行为及读出串行化等因素，完整事件响应持续时间显著延长，且重建波形在高频调制和短脉冲激励下因时间弥散和正负事件不平衡而退化，时空保真度高度依赖于感兴趣区域的几何与空间活动。
AI.motivation: 事件视觉传感器具有异步事件生成和微秒级时间戳分辨率，可能适用于高速光学测量，但精确事件时间戳并不保证时变光学信号的准确重建，尤其在密集大范围照明条件下存在操作限制，而这一知识空白在文献中尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 基于IMX636事件相机，采用频域测量评估调制响应、事件率行为、极性平衡和频谱重建保真度（在不同照明条件和感兴趣区域几何下），同时采用互补的脉冲测量量化首次事件延迟、响应持续时间、恢复动力学和脉冲宽度重建精度（在快速重复激励下）。
AI.result: 光学跃迁的首次事件延迟低于5微秒，但完整事件响应因光感受器动力学、不应期行为和读出串行化而显著延长；高频调制和短脉冲激励下重建波形因时间弥散和正负事件生成不平衡而退化；重建信号的时域保真度强烈依赖于感兴趣区域的几何与空间活动。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机在高速光学测量中具有潜力，但其时间响应和重建精度受多种因素（光感受器动力学、不应期、读出串行化、ROI几何等）制约，需在实际应用中予以考虑。

title: Ultra-high-speed line-scan Raman imaging
summary: Raman spectroscopic imaging has emerged as a potent tool due to its non-invasive nature and capability for chemical composition analysis. Line-scan Raman spectroscopy accelerates imaging speed by two orders of magnitude compared to point detection Raman methods. However, further enhancements in imaging speed were constrained by the readout speed of typically used charge-coupled device (CCD) spectroscopic detectors. We developed an ultra-fast line-scan Raman imaging technique based on recently available complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) detectors with low cost and read noise, and fast readout during exposure combined with a global shutter. Employing a high-efficiency transmissiongrating imaging spectrometer, we demonstrate imaging speeds up to two orders of magnitude faster than traditional line scan Raman imaging techniques and up to four orders of magnitude faster than point scan Raman methods, achieving Raman imaging up to 80 kHz spectral rate. We demonstrate that this technology is applicable to a variety of samples, including microplastics, biological cells, and tablets, creating images in an extremely short time frame, showcasing exceptional detection capabilities and the ability to reveal detailed information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于CMOS探测器与透射光栅成像光谱仪的超快线扫描拉曼成像技术，成像速度比传统线扫描拉曼快两个数量级，比点扫描拉曼快四个数量级，最高可达80 kHz光谱速率，并成功应用于微塑料、生物细胞和药片等样本的快速高分辨成像。
AI.motivation: 线扫描拉曼光谱虽比点扫描快两个数量级，但受限于CCD探测器读出速度，难以进一步提升成像速率，亟需开发更快的拉曼成像技术。
AI.method: 采用低成本、低读出噪声、支持曝光期间快速读出的CMOS探测器，结合全局快门与高效率透射光栅成像光谱仪，构建超快线扫描拉曼成像系统。
AI.result: 成像速度比传统线扫描拉曼快两个数量级，比点扫描拉曼快四个数量级，光谱速率达80 kHz，成功实现微塑料、生物细胞和药片等样品的超快速高分辨成像。
AI.conclusion: 基于CMOS探测器的新型线扫描拉曼成像技术突破了CCD读出速度瓶颈，极大提升了成像速度，具有优异的检测能力和细节揭示能力，适用于多种样本的快速分析。

title: When Reflection and Transmission Amplitude Coefficients Exceed Unity: Evanescent Waves, Resonances, and Optical Modes
summary: The reflection and transmission of propagating harmonic waves in linear optical systems have been widely discussed in the literature and are generally well understood. In passive systems involving only propagating waves, energy conservation constrains measurable quantities such as reflectance and transmittance, as well as the corresponding amplitude coefficients. However, when evanescent or damped waves are present, the reflection and transmission coefficients of the field amplitude may exhibit atypical behaviour, with the real or imaginary parts being much larger than one or even unbounded. In this study, we analyse this phenomenon in several simple optical configurations, including dielectric-metal interfaces, surface-plasmon-resonance prism couplers, plasmonic microcavities, step-index slab waveguides and prism-coupled waveguides. We demonstrate that these large amplitude coefficients naturally arise from extending reflection and transmission coefficients to evanescent or damped waves. On the other hand, they are not directly associated with measurable reflectance or transmittance and, therefore, do not conflict with energy conservation. Instead, they provide a useful formal description of resonant field enhancement, modal excitation and coupling processes in plasmonic and dielectric optical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在倏逝波或衰减波存在时，光学系统中反射和传输系数的异常行为（实部或虚部远大于1甚至无界），并通过多种光学结构（介质-金属界面、表面等离子体共振棱镜耦合器、等离激元微腔、阶跃折射率平板波导和棱镜耦合波导）证明这些大幅值系数是反射/传输系数向倏逝波的自然推广，虽不直接对应可测量的反射率或透射率，但为共振场增强、模式激发和耦合过程提供了有用的形式化描述。
AI.motivation: 现有文献对传播波在无源光学系统中的反射和透射已充分理解，但倏逝波或衰减波情形下反射/传输系数可能出现实部或虚部远大于1甚至无界的异常现象，需要系统分析其物理根源及与能量守恒的关系。
AI.method: 分析了多种简单光学配置（介质-金属界面、表面等离子体共振棱镜耦合器、等离激元微腔、阶跃折射率平板波导和棱镜耦合波导）中倏逝波和衰减波情形下的反射与传输系数行为。
AI.result: 大幅值振幅系数是反射/传输系数向倏逝波或衰减波的自然推广；这些系数不直接对应可测量的反射率或透射率，因此不与能量守恒冲突；它们为共振场增强、模态激发和耦合过程提供了形式化描述工具。
AI.conclusion: 倏逝波或衰减波下出现的异常大幅值系数并非物理矛盾，而是理论框架的自然延伸，在等离激元和介质光学系统中对描述共振场增强、模式激发和耦合过程具有形式化实用价值。

title: Focusing and light collection effects on plasma-induced frequency-resolved optical switching (PI-FROSt) traces
summary: Plasma-Induced Frequency-Resolved Optical Switching (PI-FROSt) is a promising and recently proposed phase-matching-free technique for characterising ultrafast pulses across broad spectral ranges. We investigate the mechanisms of PI-FROSt trace formation through numerical simulations and experimental validation. The results reveal that trace characteristics are highly sensitive to the relative focusing geometry between pump and probe pulses, as well as the spatial region selected for signal collection. Depending on these conditions, the interplay between plasma defocusing and positive lens-like nonlinear effects causes either intensity depletion or enhancement in the probe beam, flipping the PI-FROSt trace. Simulations demonstrate that optimal gate stability also depends strongly on the focusing scheme and the collecting region. This study highlights that precise spatial and temporal optimisation is essential to properly exploit the benefits of this broadband pulse characterisation technique.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值模拟和实验验证，研究了等离子体诱导频率分辨光开关（PI-FROSt）技术的痕量形成机制，发现痕量特征对泵浦和探测脉冲的相对聚焦几何以及信号收集区域高度敏感，等离子体散焦和正透镜非线性效应的相互作用会导致探测光束强度减弱或增强，从而翻转PI-FROSt痕量。研究表明，精确的空间和时间优化对于充分利用该宽带脉冲表征技术的优势至关重要。
AI.motivation: PI-FROSt是一种无需相位匹配的宽带超快脉冲表征新技术，但其痕量形成机制尚不清晰，特别是不同聚焦几何和信号收集条件对痕量特征的影响缺乏系统研究，因此需要深入探究其机理。
AI.method: 采用数值模拟与实验验证相结合的方法，系统研究泵浦-探测脉冲的相对聚焦几何和信号收集空间区域对PI-FROSt痕量形成的影响。
AI.result: PI-FROSt痕量对相对聚焦几何和信号收集区域高度敏感；等离子体散焦与正透镜非线性效应的相互作用导致探测光束强度衰减或增强，进而引起痕量翻转；门脉冲稳定性强烈依赖于聚焦方案和收集区域。
AI.conclusion: 要实现PI-FROSt宽带脉冲表征技术的最佳性能，必须进行精确的空间和时间参数优化。

title: Surface-exciton enhanced SHG response in few-layer 2H-TMDC
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, to be submitted to American Chemical Society (ACS) Photonics
summary: We explore the nonlinear optical properties of few-layer MoS2 by means of polarization and laser-power-dependent measurements as well as ab initio techniques. While for even layer samples a weak second-harmonic (SH) signal can be attributed to the presence of surface defects or interface effects, our measurements resolve a layer-number dependent signal for odd-layer samples. For the excitation energy of 780 nm, we find that the SH intensity decreases steadily with the layer number. Our simulations demonstrate that this effect cannot be purely attributed to modifications of the band structure, but requires the inclusion of excitonic effects and can be explained by the increasing delocalization of excitons with increasing sample thickness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验和理论计算研究了少层MoS₂的非线性光学性质，发现奇层数样品的二次谐波强度随层数增加而递减，该现象需考虑激子效应来解释，而非仅能归因于能带结构变化。
AI.motivation: 探究少层MoS₂中非线性光学性质（特别是二次谐波产生）随层数变化的规律及其物理机制。
AI.method: 采用偏振和激光功率依赖的二次谐波测量实验，结合第一性原理（ab initio）理论计算进行仿真分析。
AI.result: 偶层数样品中微弱的二次谐波信号归因于表面缺陷或界面效应；奇层数样品中二次谐波强度随层数增加而稳定递减（激发波长780 nm）。
AI.conclusion: 该层数依赖的二次谐波衰减不能仅由能带结构变化解释，必须考虑激子效应——随样品厚度增加，激子离域化程度增强是导致信号减弱的关键因素。

title: Two Photon excitation microscopy of individual Single-Walled Carbon Nanotubes
summary: Two-photon fluorescence imaging achieves deep-tissue penetration through long excitation wavelengths and nonlinear excitation confinement. The 1700 nm transparency window is particularly attractive, as it optimally balances tissue scattering and absorption. However, efficient fluorophores for two-photon excitation in this window remain limited. Moreover the weak near-infrared emission of individual emitters, and the low photon detection efficiency, has so far precluded single-particle imaging. Here, we characterize the two-photon excitation properties of chirality-sorted pristine and quantum color center-functionalized single-walled carbon nanotubes under 1700 nm excitation. By measuring and comparing their two-photon action cross-sections, we identify quantum color center-functionalized (6,5) nanotubes emitting at 1140 nm, as the most promising emitter, with an exceptionally large cross-section of (57 \pm 2).103 GM. Leveraging these favorable photophysical properties, we image individual nanotubes under 1700 nm excitation, to our knowledge the first demonstration of single-particle imaging at this wavelength. These results establish quantum color center-functionalized (6,5) nanotube as a strong candidate for long-wavelength two-photon imaging and lay the groundwork for deep-tissue single-particle imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文在1700 nm激发波长下，系统表征了手性分选的原生和量子色心功能化单壁碳纳米管的双光子激发特性，发现量子色心功能化的(6,5)纳米管具有异常大的双光子作用截面(57±2)×10³ GM，并首次实现了该波长下的单粒子成像，为深组织双光子成像提供了新的候选探针。
AI.motivation: 1700 nm透明窗口在双光子荧光成像中能最优地平衡组织散射和吸收，实现深层组织穿透，但该波段缺乏高效的双光子激发荧光团，且由于单个发射体的近红外发射弱以及光子探测效率低，迄今未能实现单粒子成像。
AI.method: 在1700 nm激发下，对手性分选的原生和量子色心功能化单壁碳纳米管进行双光子激发特性表征，测量并比较它们的双光子作用截面。
AI.result: 量子色心功能化的(6,5)纳米管在1140 nm发射，具有(57±2)×10³ GM的异常大双光子作用截面，并首次在1700 nm激发下实现了单个纳米管的成像。
AI.conclusion: 量子色心功能化的(6,5)纳米管是长波长双光子成像的有力候选探针，为深层组织单粒子成像奠定了基础。

title: Torsional selection rule for the spin--orbit conversion of light
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material included. Comments are welcome
summary: Standard Pancharatnam-Berry and linear-birefringent media convert optical spin into orbital angular momentum (OAM) through an anisotropy \emph{director}, a rank-two, headless field, and therefore obey the selection rule $Δ\ell=2q$ per unit texture charge $q$. We show that a medium with geometric \emph{torsion}, the continuum limit of a screw-dislocation array, can convert spin to OAM through the \emph{contortion} of its material connection, which enters the effective paraxial dynamics as a rank-one vector field. The resulting selection rule is $Δ\ell=q$. Its winding is fixed by geometry and symmetry, not by a Pancharatnam--Berry director, and the process conserves the screw charge $\tilde J_z=L_z+(q/2)σ_z$ while exchanging $(2-q)\hbar$ of angular momentum per converted photon with the defect lattice. Paraxial simulations confirm the rule: a circular Gaussian input develops a stable, topologically quantized $\ell=+q$ vortex in the reversed helicity, with $83\%$ conversion over three Rayleigh ranges and no fine-tuning. We propose a polarization-resolved photonic-lattice discriminator in which the slope of the measured OAM versus the independently written texture charge, one for torsion, two for birefringence, separates the two mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文发现具有几何扭转（螺旋位错阵列的连续极限）的介质可以通过其材料连接的扭曲效应实现自旋到轨道角动量的转换，遵循Δℓ=q的选择规则，与传统的Pancharatnam-Berry介质的Δℓ=2q规则不同，并通过傍轴模拟验证了该机制。
AI.motivation: 探索除传统Pancharatnam-Berry和线双折射介质之外的新型自旋-轨道角动量转换机制，特别是利用介质几何扭转效应实现更高效、更灵活的角动量转换。
AI.method: 理论推导了几何扭转介质中的有效傍轴动力学方程，建立了扭曲矢量场与选择规则的关联；通过傍轴模拟验证了高斯输入光在扭转介质中形成拓扑荷为ℓ=+q的涡旋；提出了偏振分辨光子晶格鉴别器以区分扭转和双折射两种机制。
AI.result: 扭转介质的选择规则为Δℓ=q（每单位纹理电荷），不同于传统介质的Δℓ=2q；模拟显示在三个瑞利距离内可实现83%的转换效率且无需精细调谐；螺旋荷J̃_z=L_z+(q/2)σ_z守恒，每个转换光子与缺陷晶格交换(2-q)ℏ角动量。
AI.conclusion: 几何扭转提供了一种全新的自旋-轨道角动量转换范式，其角动量守恒律和选择规则由几何与对称性决定，而非Pancharatnam-Berry指向矢，可通过测量OAM斜率与纹理电荷的关系区分两种机制（斜率为1对应扭转，斜率为2对应双折射）。

title: Photon-conserving Raman soliton attractors in focusing and defocusing Kerr media
summary: The sign of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient has long been regarded as irrelevant to the direction of the Raman-induced soliton self-frequency shift. Yet the standard generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) predicts a frequency shift that depends on the sign of the nonlinearity, which leads to an unphysical blue shift in the defocusing case. We resolve this inconsistency by deriving the time-domain form of the photon-conserving GNLSE (pcGNLSE) from its established frequency-domain counterpart. The derivation reveals that photon-number conservation imposes two sign modifications relative to the standard GNLSE: the Raman-shift coefficient acquires the absolute value of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient in place of its signed counterpart, and the self-steepening-Raman dissipation term likewise carries an absolute-value prefactor rather than a signed one. These two modifications jointly guarantee a universal spectral redshift and monotonically decreasing pulse energy during propagation, irrespective of the signs of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient and its frequency derivative. Applying the method of moments to the time-domain pcGNLSE with appropriate chirped ansätze, we derive closed-form evolution equations for five pulse parameters and establish explicit attractor conditions under which bright or dark Raman solitons propagate with constant peak power. Direct numerical integration of the pcGNLSE confirms all analytical predictions and demonstrates that the standard GNLSE fails qualitatively, predicting unphysical energy growth and spectral blueshift in the negative-nonlinearity regime. The results provide a rigorous analytical framework for Raman soliton dynamics in materials with negative third-order susceptibility, with direct implications for soliton-based devices in emerging semiconductor waveguide and microresonator platforms.

title: Calibration of systematic distortions in quantum emitter localization microscopy for deterministic nanophotonic fabrication
summary: Quantum photonic technologies greatly benefit from quantum light emitters with high brightness, indistinguishability, and reliable polarization characteristics. Achieving optimal performance relies on the accurate localization of emitters and their deterministic integration into tailored photonic structures with nanometer-scale accuracy. Although marker-based photoluminescence imaging techniques can achieve statistical fitting uncertainties below 10 nm, the ultimate integration yield is often limited by uncorrected systematic distortions in custom cryo-optical setups that compromise metrological accuracy. Here, we present an in situ calibration protocol that uses lithographically defined gold nanodisk arrays as references to calibrate optical distortions with a Zernike vector-field model. On held-out validation patterns beyond the calibration dataset, this correction reduces the residual systematic bias to 5.3 nm with a 2D scatter of 24.6 nm across the analyzed field of view. Furthermore, we demonstrate that applying this correction to the deterministic fabrication of circular mesa structures around semiconductor quantum dots reduces the variance in emission polarization by 49%, indicating improved registration accuracy. This calibration strategy offers a practical route to high-yield deterministic integration of quantum emitters into scalable quantum photonic circuits.
